title: Technical Project Manager / Mechanical Designer
description:
Shape the Future of Food Production - Technical Project Manager / Mechanical Designer within Industrial Machinery and Process Equipment
Do you want a key role where you can combine project management, design, drafting, problem-solving, and hands-on execution? We are looking for a technically strong and proactive individual who can drive projects from concept and development to final installation, commissioning, and handover - and who enjoys working closely with both customers and teams.

About Livoo

Livoo is an innovative food technology and ingredients company focused on creating new value from existing food resources.
We combine technology, sustainability and circularity to transform food industry side streams into high-quality, functional ingredients with real commercial value.
Our ingredient portfolio includes OATup®, a circular oat-based ingredient with a strong nutritional and functional profile and applications across several food categories.

About the Role

As a Technical Project Manager / Mechanical Designer, you will be responsible for leading technical projects related to industrial machinery, process equipment, and production solutions. You will work closely with production, suppliers, workshops, external technical consultants, and internal stakeholders - often in an international context.
The role includes clear responsibility for both design and CAD drafting, where you produce documentation used directly in workshops and production. You will also play an important role in customer interactions, ensuring you understand requirements, communicate solutions, and deliver projects according to agreed specifications and contracts.
You enjoy working in teams, collaborating across functions, and building strong relationships with customers and partners.

What will you be responsible for?
- Lead technical projects from planning through execution, installation, and commissioning.
- Produce design drawings, manufacturing documentation, and technical documentation in CAD.
- Ensure drawings are accurate, manufacturable, and adapted for workshops or external suppliers.
- Actively participate in the development of new machine solutions, process equipment, and production improvements.
- Manage customer dialogue throughout projects - from needs analysis to follow-up and delivery.
- Ensure projects are executed according to contract, specifications, and agreed scope.
- Coordinate suppliers, installers, workshops, and internal stakeholders.
- Participate in installation, testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning of equipment.
- Identify technical risks, propose solutions, and drive improvements.
- Ensure technical solutions are practical, cost-effective, and robust.
- Contribute to structure, documentation, and standardization of technical solutions.

Who are we looking for?
- Experience in project management within industry, mechanical engineering, process equipment, or production.
- Strong CAD skills and experience independently producing manufacturing drawings.
- Understanding of mechanical design, machine components, and industrial installations.
- Experience with commissioning, start-up, or technical troubleshooting in production environments.
- Experience in customer interaction and the ability to manage and lead customer dialogue in projects.
- Ability to work in a structured and detail-oriented manner, following contracts, requirements, and project scope.
- Ability to clearly communicate technical solutions with customers, workshops, suppliers, and internal teams.
- A practical and solution-oriented mindset.
- Strong ability to plan, prioritize, and drive projects forward.
- Good proficiency in English, as you will work in an international environment.

Meritorious
- Experience from process industry, food production, automation, or industrial machinery.
- Knowledge of hygienic design, stainless steel, piping, pumps, valves, or process flows.
- Experience with CE marking, machine safety, or technical documentation.
- Experience in supplier management, procurement, or workshop manufacturing.
- Knowledge of automation, PLCs, electrical systems, or control systems is a plus, but not required.

Personal Qualities

To succeed in this role, we believe you are someone who takes responsibility, is detail-oriented and structured, and sees solutions where others see problems. You are technically curious and confident in making decisions when projects need to move forward.
You enjoy working in teams and collaborate easily with colleagues, customers, and external partners. You like interacting with people, building relationships, and taking ownership of communication throughout the entire project.

You appreciate working close to reality, seeing the results of your work in production, and being a key link between idea, design, manufacturing, and operation.

Why join Livoo?

An opportunity to build, not just maintain
You will join a growing international food ingredients business at an exciting stage of its development.

You will have significant freedom to identify customers, develop markets and shape commercial opportunities.

International Exposure
Work with food manufacturers, product developers and industry partners across Sweden and European markets.

Real Responsibility
You will have genuine ownership of your customers, pipeline and commercial results.

Your contribution will be visible - and your success will make a direct difference to Livoo's growth.

Competitive Compensation
We offer a competitive fixed salary with the opportunity for performance-based compensation linked to commercial results.

What we offer
- A broad and impactful technical role with significant influence.
- The opportunity to work with development, design, drafting, project management, and hands-on execution.
- An international work environment with cross-border collaboration.
- Close collaboration with production, management, and external specialists.
- A culture where problem-solving, curiosity, and initiative are part of everyday work.
- The opportunity to help build efficient and future-proof industrial solutions within foodtech.

How to apply

Please submit your CV together with a short introduction describing your relevant sales experience and why you are interested in joining Livoo.

For questions regarding the position, please contact:
Stefan Ekstrand
CEO, Livoo AB

title: HSE Specialist for Megaproject in Luleå, Northern Sweden
description:
NCC Green Industry Transformation

Sweden is facing a historic transformation. Heavy industry is undergoing a shift, paving the way for a fossil-free future that creates significant value in terms of economic growth, technological development, and the environment. As an important part of community development in northern Sweden—where some of the most critical investments are taking place—we are now seeking a driven Health, Safety & Environment Specialist (HSE), a key role in one of our complex projects in Northern Sweden.

The role as HSE Specialist

Do you want to help shape the industry of the future and play a key role in complex projects – in a safe and sustainable way? As a HSE Specialist on one of Sweden’s largest construction projects, you will have a central role in driving and developing systematic health and safety work on site. This is a role where your contribution truly makes a difference – every day, in the operation.

You will work closely with production and other project functions on matters such as safety inspections, statistics, risk assessments, incident and non-conformance management, and preventative health and safety initiatives. You will lead and participate in meetings, and develop instructions and presentation materials.

This role is not just about rules and procedures – it is about creating a strong, active safety culture where people thrive, perform, and return home safely. With a physical presence on the construction site, and close collaboration with the client and all project functions, you will help build both structure and culture.

You will report to our Head of Staff and become part of a committed team in an organisation where your efforts make a real difference.

Your profile

We are looking for someone with experience from large-scale projects – preferably in construction and/or industrial projects or environments – where you have worked hands-on with health and safety issues. You have relevant education or equivalent knowledge gained through professional experience, and you are confident in taking ownership of your area.

You are used to driving initiatives independently and joining projects at an early stage, where you will develop and implement processes. At the same time, you work in close collaboration with the client and other professional roles in complex environments. You are proficient in both Swedish and English, and have the ability to communicate clearly and engagingly, both in conversation and in presentations.

Would you like to be part of something significant – while contributing to a safe and sustainable working environment for every individual on site? Then we would very much like to meet you.

Location

On-site presence in the city of Luleå (North of Sweden) is set to at least 50% of working hours—and at certain periods, the role will require close to full-time presence on site in Luleå. This is a prerequisite for succeeding in the role. However, it is possible to take on this exciting opportunity even if you are based elsewhere in Sweden, provided you have good travel options to Luleå (e.g., Boden, Piteå, Skellefteå, Stockholm, Uppsala, etc.). NCC will arrange travel and accommodation within Sweden.

For this position, background checks are conducted in accordance with NCC’s security culture.

Swedish Work Permit

Candidates must have the legal right to work in Sweden. The role requires regular on-site presence in Sweden and limited relocation support is available.

NCC Offers

NCC strives to be an attractive employer where employees thrive, grow, and feel well. We therefore offer a wide range of employee benefits and internal training opportunities. NCC has collective agreements for all employees, providing a solid foundation of security and clear terms of employment. We also offer insurance, reduced working hours, wellness allowances, and lunch benefits. Additional offers and discounts are available through our benefits portal, Benify.

Contact and Application

For more information about the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Specialist Wuendy Cardenas at wuendy.cardenas@ncc.se.

Application deadline: October 23rd, 2026.

Selection will be carried out on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application date.

Welcome with your application!

Build with us and join the industry’s best team!

NCC – one of the leading construction companies in the Nordic region

At NCC, we are driven by continuous development—whether it concerns our construction projects or our personal expertise. Every day, we move the industry’s most exciting and complex construction projects forward through close collaboration between our employees, partners, and clients. With us, you are a valuable team member contributing to the landmarks that define our cities and communities.

Here, our employees take an active role in a corporate culture based on strong values and behaviors that promote a safe and secure workplace. Our combined expertise and diverse backgrounds make a difference.

We kindly decline contact from advertising and recruitment service sales representatives regarding this assignment.

title: Trygg och lyhörd assistent sökes till man på Hisingen!
description:
Vem är jag?
Jag är en social och aktiv man i 40-årsåldern. Jag har Angelmans syndrom och epilepsi, vilket innebär att jag behöver hjälp med mycket i min vardag - från måltid och personlig hygien till att tolka mina signaler och förstå vad jag vill. Det är dock inga tunga lyft. Jag kan gå själv, men ibland behöver jag lite stöd för balansen, och när benen blir trötta använder jag rullstol. Jag kommunicerar inte med ord, men du kommer snabbt lära dig att förstå mig. Jag visar med händerna när jag är hungrig, törstig eller vill något annat.

Min värld kretsar kring enkla men härliga saker. Jag älskar att ta promenader, bada och gå ut och äta - pizza är en given favorit! Att sitta ute och kanske njuta av en öl eller bara omges av människor gör mig glad. Jag bor i en egen, rymlig lägenhet på Hisingen där du som assistent sover i ditt eget rum och det också finns ett personalrum att använda under dina arbetspass.

Vem är du?
Jag letar efter någon som kan hjälpa mig att skapa en trygg och rolig vardag. Det är viktigt att du kan laga mat eftersom jag älskar god mat - framför allt hemlagad! Det är bra om du är lugn, trygg och lyhörd, men det kanske allra viktigaste är att du har ett stort hjärta och vill förstå mig och mina behov. Du behöver kunna prata flytande svenska så att vi kan förstå varandra.

Tjänstens upplägg:
Extra vid behov. Arbetstiderna 07:00-07:00 alternativt 18:00-07:00, dvs hel- och halvdygn.

Vid intresse så finns det även möjlighet till fasta arbetspass på schema tom maj 2027, det innebär ca 1-2 arbetspass per vecka.

Passal Assistans erbjuder ett varierande och givande arbete med goda anställningsvillkor, utbildningar och friskvårdsbidrag. Timlön enligt överenskommelse och övriga ersättningar enligt kollektivavtal. Du får också bra stöttning från assistansansvarig.

Du som söker denna tjänst måste kunna visa upp en giltig ID-handling som pass eller nationellt ID (körkort ej giltigt) samt utdrag ur belastningsregistret vid intervjutillfället. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du kunna uppvisa upp ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller permanent uppehållstillstånd för att få arbeta hos oss.

Passal Assistans arbetar med personlig assistans och drivs av personer med stort engagemang och lång erfarenhet av arbete med människor med funktionsvariation. På Passal Assistans är det viktigt att alla känner sig som en del av helheten, att alla inser sin betydelse. Vår vision är ett samhälle och en vardag där alla har friheten att leva fullt ut. Vi ser personlig assistans som en möjlighet att nå den visionen.

Välkommen med din ansökan!
Annonsens referensnummer: 1167
Ansvarig rekryterare: David Henriksson

title: Truckförare till Nykvarn - 2 skift
description:
Är du en skicklig truckförare som vill arbeta hos ett världsledande bolag i Nykvarn? Simplex har nu en spännande möjlighet för dig.

Beskrivning av arbetsrollen

Som truckförare hos vår kund i Nykvarn kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i deras logistikverksamhet. Du ansvarar för säker och effektiv hantering av varor inom lager- och produktionsmiljöer. Arbetet erbjuds i ett strukturerat skiftsystem som stödjer verksamhetens olika behov.

Ansvarsområden som Truckförare

    Effektiv hantering och lagring av inkommande och utgående gods
    Truckkörning och produktionsstöd i dynamiska miljöer
    Upprätthålla korrekt inventering med skanning och registrering
    Samarbeta med teamet för att optimera logistiska flöden

Din profil

Vi söker en pålitlig och noggrann person som trivs i en dynamisk och tempofylld arbetsmiljö. Du är engagerad, gillar att lösa problem och är van vid att anpassa dig till förändrade förhållanden. God kommunikationsförmåga är avgörande för samarbete i team.

Önskade kvalifikationer och krav

    Truckkort A1-4 och B1-4
    Tidigare erfarenhet av truckkörning i lager- eller produktionsmiljö
    God förmåga att arbeta självständigt och i team
    Körkort B är ett krav
    Förmåga att hantera stress med fokus på säkerhet och kvalitet

Meriterande vuxet i rollen

    Erfarenhet av att använda skjutstativstruck och motviktstruck är extra meriterande

Arbetstider och plats

Plats: Nykvarn

Omfattning: Heltid

Arbetstider: 2 skift (06:00-14:21 samt 14:30-22:51)

Om Simplex

Simplex är ett ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag, specialiserat på att öppna dörrar för individer och skapa tillväxt för företag. Vår styrka ligger i att matcha rätt talang till rätt plats, vilket skapar värdefulla resultat för alla inblandade. Vi har en stark närvaro inom lager och logistik runtom i Sverige och jobbar aktivt för att utveckla våra konsulter och kunder.

Välkommen till Simplex och en möjlighet att vara en del av något stort!

title: Solna tingsrätt söker handläggarassistenter!
description:
Solna tingsrätt är en öppen, modern och utvecklingsinriktad arbetsplats med engagerade medarbetare. Domstolen är med omkring 145 medarbetare en av de största tingsrätterna i Sverige. Här handläggs ett stort antal brottmål, tvistemål och domstolsärenden. Solna tingsrätt har fyra dömande avdelningar och en administrativ avdelning. Verksamheten kännetecknas av hög kvalitet vilket möjliggörs genom ett gott samarbete mellan medarbetare, oavsett yrkesroll eller organisatorisk tillhörighet. På tingsrätten arbetar vi aktivt med att förbättra och utveckla verksamheten där du med ditt engagemang får chans att bidra. Vår strävan är att alla på tingsrätten ska bemötas vänligt och respektfullt. Tingsrätten verkar för att det ska finnas goda möjligheter att förena arbete med privatliv. Vi arbetar i moderna lokaler i centrala Solna.

Varje dag avgörs hundratals mål och ärenden i domstolarna runt om i Sverige. Vår organisation består av medarbetare med olika kompetenser, där var och en är betydelsefull i att upprätthålla rättssäkerhet och hög kvalitet i alla led.

För att säkerställa en inkluderande och rättvis rekryteringsprocess tillämpar Sveriges Domstolar kompetensbaserad rekrytering. Vårt urval bygger på kandidaternas kompetenser och meriter. Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

2 plats(er).


Solna tingsrätt söker dig som är juriststudent och som vill kombinera dina studier med extrajobb som handläggarassistent inom domstolsväsendet.

Arbetet innebär

Som handläggarassistent arbetar du med enklare uppgifter på tingsrättens målkanslier.

Du kommer att

    registrera inkommande handlingar
    kommunicera i mål och ärenden samt utföra andra sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter på kansli
    besvara inkommande samtal

Du kommer att ingå i vår "vikariepool" och arbeta på den avdelning som behöver dig mest den aktuella dagen. På avdelningen kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med handläggare, domare och notarier.

Vi söker dig som

    studerar på juristprogrammet
    snabbt tar in ny kunskap och använder din erfarenhet på ett flexibelt sätt
    är både serviceinriktad, kvalitetsmedveten och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra
    har förmåga att prioritera uppgifter efter verksamhetens behov
    har god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift
    har goda kunskaper i Officepaketet och ser dator, e-post och telefon som naturliga arbetsverktyg.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet. Arbetspsykologiska tester kommer att användas vid denna rekrytering.

Vad vi erbjuder

Anställningen är en visstidsanställning, deltid vid behov. Vi kommer löpande överens om arbetstider, med utgångspunkten att du kan vara tillgänglig minst en arbetsdag i veckan. Vi erbjuder en spännande arbetsplats där du får inblick i det dagliga arbetet på en samhällsviktig myndighet.

Ansök så här

1.Bifoga CV och personligt brev. Motivera i personliga brevet varför du söker anställningen och beskriv på vilket sätt du kan bidra till tingsrättens verksamhet.

2. Ladda upp studieintyg som visar att du har en pågående eftergymnasial utbildning på juristprogrammet. Komplettera din ansökan med studieintyget snarast möjligt om du inte redan har det att tillgå.

Ansök senast: 7 oktober 2026

Hos oss tillämpar vi individuell och differentierad lönesättning. Vill du veta mer om hur vi arbetar med lön och se aktuella löneintervall för olika befattningar, kan du läsa mer på vår externa webbplats: Jobba hos oss – Förmåner och villkor – Lön.

Löneform: Timlön.
Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: 2026-11-02  .

title: Är du vår nya QHSE Advisor?
description:
Om rollen  

Som QHSE Advisor hos oss har du en roll där arbetsmiljö och säkerhet är en naturlig del av det dagliga arbetet. Du bidrar till att omsätta mål, krav och ambitioner till fungerande arbetssätt genom nära samarbete med chefer och medarbetare.  

Rollen innebär att du rör dig mellan våra anläggningar runt om i landet, främst i mellersta och södra Sverige, och är en aktiv del av vardagen i verksamheten. Genom dialog, samarbete och förståelse för hur arbetet bedrivs bidrar du till att arbetsmiljöarbetet blir relevant, användbart och levande. Det här är en roll för dig som aktivt vill vara med och bidra till en bättre arbetsmiljö och färre olyckor. 

 

I ditt arbete ansvarar du för att:  

    

Driva och utveckla det systematiska arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsarbetet i samverkan med chefer och skyddsorganisation  

    

Stötta i riskbedömningar, skyddsronder samt tillbuds- och olycksutredningar  

    

Höja medvetenheten kring och utbilda inom KMA/QHSE  

    

Genomföra interna revisioner enligt ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 och 50001 samt inspektioner enligt befintliga program  

    

Ansvara för kemikaliehantering och sammankalla kemikalieråd  

    

Arbeta med miljö- och arbetsmiljöregelverk samt hantera myndighetskontakter inom ditt ansvarsområde  

    

Bidra till hållbarhetsarbetet genom att integrera miljömässiga och sociala perspektiv i vardagens arbetssätt  

    

Hålla dig uppdaterad kring lagstiftning, bestämmelser och krav inom miljö- och arbetsmiljöområdet  
 

Tyngdpunkten i rollen ligger på Safety och arbetsmiljö i det dagliga arbetet, med kvalitet, miljö och hållbarhet som naturliga delar av helheten.  

 

Organisation och placering  

Du rapporterar till QHSE‑chefen och är placerad på vår anläggning i Upplands Väsby alternativt Landvetter. Du ingår i ett team med ytterligare en QHSE Advisor och en Process Manager, samt två kollegor i Norge.   

 

Vi söker dig som:  

    

Tror på att verklig förändring inom arbetsmiljö och säkerhet skapas genom närvaro, dialog och samarbete med människor

    

Du är trygg i att bidra i den operativa verksamheten, där du bygger förtroende genom ditt sätt att arbeta.

    

Har utbildning inom arbetsmiljö eller motsvarande

    

Har erfarenhet av praktiskt och verksamhetsnära arbetsmiljöarbete

    

Har erfarenhet av att driva förändringsarbete och ta fram samt implementera arbetssätt inom arbetsmiljö och miljö

    

Har erfarenhet av kemikaliehantering

    

Tar ansvar, är flexibel och kan prioritera när arbetsuppgifterna är många

    

Är nyfiken på hur AI och digitala hjälpmedel kan stödja ett mer effektivt och verksamhetsnära arbetsmiljöarbete

    

Uttrycker dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska

    

Har B‑körkort – resor är en naturlig och frekvent del av tjänsten
  

För ytterligare information om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Conny Hansson, QHSE Manager, via e-post på conny.hansson@zeppelin.com eller telefon 0705-100073.

  

Tjänsten kan tillsättas omgående eller enligt överenskommelse. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

  

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller.

title: Erfarna snickare sökes till Gällivare
description:
Nkraft söker snickare till Gällivare - Vi ordnar boende!

Vi växer och söker nu skickliga snickare för uppdrag i Norrbotten. Är du en driven och erfaren yrkesperson som vill vara en del av ett starkt team? Då kan detta vara något för dig!

Om jobbet:

    Skiftgång: måndag-torsdag eller måndag-fredag
    Arbete med nyproduktion, renovering och ombyggnation.
    Varierande uppdrag hos våra kunder inom bygg och anläggning.
    Start omgående eller enligt överenskommelse.

Vi erbjuder:

    Konkurrenskraftig lön enligt kollektivavtal.
    Boende ordnas
    Trygga anställningsvillkor och bra arbetsmiljö.
    Möjlighet till långsiktiga uppdrag.

Vi söker dig som:

    Har erfarenhet minst 3 år som snickare.
    Är självgående och noggrann i ditt arbete.
    Har B-körkort
    Har yrkesbevis eller motsvarande erfarenhet.

Låter detta som något för dig? Skicka din ansökan idag!

title: HSE Specialist for Megaproject in Luleå, Northern Sweden
description:
NCC Green Industry Transformation

Sweden is facing a historic transformation. Heavy industry is undergoing a shift, paving the way for a fossil-free future that creates significant value in terms of economic growth, technological development, and the environment. As an important part of community development in northern Sweden—where some of the most critical investments are taking place—we are now seeking a driven Health, Safety & Environment Specialist (HSE), a key role in one of our complex projects in Northern Sweden.

The role as HSE Specialist

Do you want to help shape the industry of the future and play a key role in complex projects – in a safe and sustainable way? As a HSE Specialist on one of Sweden’s largest construction projects, you will have a central role in driving and developing systematic health and safety work on site. This is a role where your contribution truly makes a difference – every day, in the operation.

You will work closely with production and other project functions on matters such as safety inspections, statistics, risk assessments, incident and non-conformance management, and preventative health and safety initiatives. You will lead and participate in meetings, and develop instructions and presentation materials.

This role is not just about rules and procedures – it is about creating a strong, active safety culture where people thrive, perform, and return home safely. With a physical presence on the construction site, and close collaboration with the client and all project functions, you will help build both structure and culture.

You will report to our Head of Staff and become part of a committed team in an organisation where your efforts make a real difference.

Your profile

We are looking for someone with experience from large-scale projects – preferably in construction and/or industrial projects or environments – where you have worked hands-on with health and safety issues. You have relevant education or equivalent knowledge gained through professional experience, and you are confident in taking ownership of your area.

You are used to driving initiatives independently and joining projects at an early stage, where you will develop and implement processes. At the same time, you work in close collaboration with the client and other professional roles in complex environments. You are proficient in both Swedish and English, and have the ability to communicate clearly and engagingly, both in conversation and in presentations.

Would you like to be part of something significant – while contributing to a safe and sustainable working environment for every individual on site? Then we would very much like to meet you.

Location

On-site presence in the city of Luleå (North of Sweden) is set to at least 50% of working hours—and at certain periods, the role will require close to full-time presence on site in Luleå. This is a prerequisite for succeeding in the role. However, it is possible to take on this exciting opportunity even if you are based elsewhere in Sweden, provided you have good travel options to Luleå (e.g., Boden, Piteå, Skellefteå, Stockholm, Uppsala, etc.). NCC will arrange travel and accommodation within Sweden.

For this position, background checks are conducted in accordance with NCC’s security culture.

Swedish Work Permit

Candidates must have the legal right to work in Sweden. The role requires regular on-site presence in Sweden and limited relocation support is available.

NCC Offers

NCC strives to be an attractive employer where employees thrive, grow, and feel well. We therefore offer a wide range of employee benefits and internal training opportunities. NCC has collective agreements for all employees, providing a solid foundation of security and clear terms of employment. We also offer insurance, reduced working hours, wellness allowances, and lunch benefits. Additional offers and discounts are available through our benefits portal, Benify.

Contact and Application

For more information about the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Specialist Wuendy Cardenas at wuendy.cardenas@ncc.se.

Application deadline: October 23rd, 2026.

Selection will be carried out on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application date.

Welcome with your application!

Build with us and join the industry’s best team!

NCC – one of the leading construction companies in the Nordic region

At NCC, we are driven by continuous development—whether it concerns our construction projects or our personal expertise. Every day, we move the industry’s most exciting and complex construction projects forward through close collaboration between our employees, partners, and clients. With us, you are a valuable team member contributing to the landmarks that define our cities and communities.

Here, our employees take an active role in a corporate culture based on strong values and behaviors that promote a safe and secure workplace. Our combined expertise and diverse backgrounds make a difference.

We kindly decline contact from advertising and recruitment service sales representatives regarding this assignment.

title: Danish-speaking Customer Service Representative - Remote work
description:
Do you love building relationships and do you have a passion for fashion? As a Danish-speaking Customer Service Representative, you’ll have the opportunity to help customers, resolve issues, and provide world-class service – all while working remotely from Sweden or from our office in Borås. Sounds interesting? Join Transcom and start your journey today!

What’s in it for YOU!

• Security: We have a collective agreement ensuring fair terms and a secure contract.

• Flexibility: Opportunity to work fully remote within Sweden or from our modern office in Borås.

• Benefits: Rikskortet (subsidized lunch) to save money in your daily life, and a wellness allowance (Friskvårdsbidrag) as we care about your health.

• Career: No ambition is too big. 90% of our managers and leaders started their journey on the phone – we focus on internal promotion.

• Paid training: We provide you with the right tools and prerequisites to succeed in your role from day one.

Your role as a Danish-speaking Customer Service Representative

Become the face of our client – an international company within the fashion industry with a focus on quality and customer service. In this role, you will:

• Deliver a world-class customer experience by handling queries regarding online orders, deliveries, and returns in a timely and accurate way;

• Communicate effectively and professionally via phone, email, chat, and social media;

• Handle written inquiries in Norwegian and contribute to the team's success by sharing knowledge with colleagues.

• Opening hours: Monday–Friday 08:00–18:00, Saturdays 09:00–15:00 (shifts are scheduled within these hours). Sundays closed.

Who are you?

To be successful in this role, we see that the following matches your profile:

• Fluent in Danish (speaking and writing, native level or C1) and a good understanding of written Norwegian

• Strong communication skills and interpersonal abilities such as empathy and listening;

• You have strong technical aptitude and find it easy to learn new systems and digital tools

• You absorb information quickly and adapt easily to changing circumstances

• A positive attitude and a passion for delivering a first-class customer experience – you believe the customer deserves more than just support.

In order to work from home, you will need to have:

• A stable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps (fiber/cable).

• A quiet and suitable working environment at home.

About Transcom

Transcom is a global specialist in customer service and customer satisfaction through our extensive network of 90 contact centers in 29 countries and 33 languages. We are driven by innovation and have a passion for helping people solve problems. We are also one of Sweden’s largest employers of young people. At Transcom, we are committed. To our clients and to each other. Every day, someone starts their journey with Transcom. Taking the potential they have today and turning it into skills for the future. Being recognized for working hard, being a team player, and supporting others. Contributing to positive and lasting change in their team and community. That’s exactly how we are at Transcom. Here, we care about each other. You are included, just as you are, from day one. With the right mindset, there is no limit to how far we can go together.

"We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law."

title: PHE and English Teacher – Bladins International School of Malmö
description:
At Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM), we are looking for an enthusiastic and committed Physical and Health Education (PHE) and English Teacher to join our Middle Years Programme (MYP) for a one-year parental leave cover, starting in January 2027.

If you are a dedicated teacher who enjoys inspiring students, building positive relationships and working in an international environment, we would love to hear from you.

About Bladins International School of Malmö

Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM) is an IB Continuum School located in central Malmö. We offer the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 370 students representing a wide range of nationalities and cultures. We are proud to be part of a global network of IB World Schools.

As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation with a long tradition of academic excellence, we are committed to providing a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students are encouraged to become knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.

The Role

As a PHE and English Teacher in our MYP, you will plan, teach and assess students in PHE and English and contribute actively to their academic, social and personal development.

You will work closely with colleagues within the relevant subject teams and across the school to provide engaging, inclusive and high-quality learning experiences for our students.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Planning and delivering engaging MYP lessons in PHE and English

    

Assessing and supporting students' learning and development

    

Creating a safe, inclusive and motivating learning environment

    

Adapting teaching to meet the different needs and abilities of students

    

Collaborating closely with colleagues and contributing to subject and school development

    

Building positive and professional relationships with students, colleagues and families

    

Contributing actively to the wider school community

title: Enhetschef till Parkenheten
description:
Vänersborg, regionhuvudstad i Västra Götaland, är belägen vid Vänerns sydspets och har drygt 40 000 invånare. Här kombineras fina, centrumnära badstränder som möjliggör ett dopp i Sveriges största sjö på lunchrasten med goda kommunikationer och ett attraktivt pendlingsläge.



Beskrivning

Gatuenheten är en del av Samhällsbyggnadsförvaltningen och ansvarar för en stor del av den offentliga miljön såsom kommunens gator, vägar, gång- och cykelvägar, parker, lekplatser och allmänna platser. Vi sköter även kommunägda badplatser, skogar, jordbruksmark och vatten. Naturvård och naturanknutet friluftsliv samt trafik- och parkeringsfrågor ligger också inom Gatuenhetens ansvarsområde. Vi hanterar dessutom frågor som rör våra småbåtshamnar och båtplatser, torg och flaggning.

Parkenheten är en av fyra enheter på Gatuenheten. Enheten är en drivande part i kommunens stadsutveckling. Vi förvaltar och utvecklar stadens parker, lekplatser, naturområden, sjöar och vattendrag. Enheten ansvarar också för vinterbelysning och julgranar. På uppdrag av andra förvaltningar/enheter utför vi även barmarksrenhållning, grönskötsel, vinterväghållning, yttre skötsel på skolgårdar, underhåll samt nybyggnation av markanläggningar. I vårt arbete strävar vi efter att ha hög effektivitet, produktivitet och kvalitet med en önskan att uppfattas professionella, engagerade och nyfikna att skapa en kommun med goda visioner om framtiden.

Gatuenheten ger sina medarbetare möjligheter att utvecklas och hos oss är det viktigt med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid. Vänersborgs kommun arbetar vi aktivt för att skapa hälsofrämjande arbetsplatser med en god arbetsmiljö.

Är du en engagerad ledare som vill göra skillnad? Nu söker vi dig som vill fortsätta utveckla verksamheten och skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för medarbetare att trivas, utvecklas och lyckas i sitt uppdrag.

Arbetsuppgifter

Dina huvudsakliga uppgifter blir att planera, leda, genomföra och följa upp delar inom enheten för drift- och underhåll samt investeringsprojekt, utifrån politiskt fattade beslut.

Inom enheten finns arbetsledare, parkarbetare och kommunvärdar. Personalstyrkan varierar över året och omfattar mellan 10 och 25 medarbetare, för vilka du har personal- och arbetsmiljöansvar. Du ansvarar även för enhetens budget.

I uppdraget ingår bland annat att hantera felanmälningar, ta fram skötselplaner, lämna yttranden i detaljplaneärenden, upprätta ekonomiska prognoser samt föredra och presentera ärenden för politiken.

Du är en aktiv och drivande part i enhetens utvecklingsarbete och medverkar i interna projekt inom exempelvis digitalisering, processutveckling och verksamhetsutveckling. Du samverkar med olika aktörer både inom och utanför kommunen, exempelvis andra förvaltningar, entreprenörer och invånare. Som medlem i gatuenhetens ledningsgrupp, bestående av fyra personer, är du med och driver verksamhetens utveckling och långsiktiga inriktning. Tillsammans med medarbetare och kollegor bidrar du till att gatuenheten når sina mål och utvecklas som en effektiv och hållbar verksamhet.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är en trygg och engagerad ledare som trivs i en verksamhetsnära roll. Du har förmåga att skapa struktur, driva frågor framåt och fatta beslut samtidigt som du är lyhörd och bygger goda relationer med medarbetare, kollegor och samverkansparter. Rollen ställer höga krav på samarbete, kommunikation och ett stort engagemang för verksamhetens utveckling.

Vi söker dig som har:

    Eftergymnasial utbildning inom trädgård, parkförvaltning, samhällsbyggnad eller annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant för uppdraget. Alternativt har du förvärvat motsvarande kunskaper genom flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet.
    Flera års erfarenhet av drift- och underhållsarbete.
    God administrativ förmåga och erfarenhet av att arbeta i olika verksamhetssystem.
    Goda kunskaper inom ärendehantering, fakturering och dokumentation.
    God förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska.
    B-körkort.

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Tidigare erfarenhet av chefskap eller arbetsledning.
    Erfarenhet från politiskt styrd verksamhet.
    Erfarenhet av utvecklings- och förändringsarbete.

Som person är du strukturerad, beslutsam och handlingskraftig med förmåga att prioritera och skapa resultat. Du trivs med att ta ansvar och har ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt i ditt arbete. Du ser värdet av utvecklings- och kvalitetsarbete och vill bidra till att verksamheten ständigt förbättras och utvecklas.

Genom ett närvarande och verksamhetsnära ledarskap skapar du förtroende, delaktighet och engagemang hos dina medarbetare. Du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta med olika aktörer, både internt och externt.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.





Villkor

Tjänsten är en dagtidstjänst med flexibel arbetstid. Beredskapstjänstgöring kan komma att ingå i uppdraget.

Intervjuer kan komma att genomföras löpande under annonseringstiden. Tester ingår som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.

Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll genomförs innan anställning.

Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.



Om Vänersborgs kommun

Som medarbetare i Vänersborgs kommun bidrar du till att göra vardagen enklare för våra 40 000 medborgare i kommunen. I Vänersborgs kommun jobbar 3 600 anställda och vi arbetar för att vara attraktiv och hållbar i alla delar, hela livet.

Vi arbetar med individuell lönesättning och erbjuder förmåner kopplade till anställningen.

Vill du veta mer om oss som arbetsgivare, våra förmåner och hur vår lönesättning fungerar? Besök vår karriärsida .

Övrig information

Vi ser mångfald som en styrka som berikar vår verksamhet och välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund. Har du skyddade personuppgifter vänligen kontakta kontaktpersonen för annonsen via telefon och skicka din ansökan via post.

Kommunen har gjort aktiva val i denna rekrytering och vill därför inte bli kontaktade med erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp/kompetensförmedling. Kontaktuppgifter till din fackliga organisation hittar du här .

title: Thesis work - Regulatory and Operational Implications of Moving Inter-Array
description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company serving approximately 12 million customers and employing around 21,000 people. We believe there is a way to build a future where everyone can choose fossil-free ways to move, make, and live.

Om rollen

Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you will have the opportunity to complete your thesis project close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference.

Vattenfall R&D is responsible for conducting business driven technical development that creates value for the company and helps us realize our strategy. We develop cost effective, safe and sustainable solutions to improve the infrastructure of Vattenfall assets including Wind, Hydro, Nuclear, SKB, Heat, and Distribution.  

Offshore wind farms are continuously increasing in size and generation capacity. As a result, the nominal voltage of inter-array cable systems has evolved from traditional medium-voltage levels to 66 kV in current state-of-the-art designs. With the next generation of offshore wind turbines expected to reach capacities of up to 20 MW, the industry is moving towards 132 kV inter-array cable systems to enable efficient power collection and transmission within wind farms.

Inter-array cables are critical assets that connect wind turbines to offshore substations and directly impact the reliability and availability of offshore wind farms. The challenges associated with these installations are significant, particularly due to the need for the highest quality and precision during installation and commissioning. Any cable failure can result in substantial losses from reduced energy production, while locating and repairing faults offshore requires considerable time, cost, and resources.

This thesis aims to assess the regulatory and operational implications of operating inter-array cable systems at 132 kV, focusing on the transition from medium-voltage to high-voltage operation in offshore wind farms.

The project will provide an overview of the regulatory and operational framework needed for 132 kV inter-array cable systems and support the offshore wind industry in preparing for the next generation of high-capacity wind farm designs.

This thesis work is for 1 student.

Kravspecifikation

We are looking for a student who is about to complete their academic studies and is eager to apply their knowledge in a real-world setting through a thesis project at Vattenfall. You are someone who shares our values and identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive and Safety.

    Understanding of power systems with emphasis on high voltage systems.

title: Postdoctoral researcher in Human Work Science
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The research subject Human Work Science at Luleå University of Technology is seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join an engaging research environment focused on the work environment, advanced technology and sustainable societal development. The successful candidate will work in research projects concerning the role of humans in sociotechnical systems and how these systems should be designed to support a sustainable green and digital transition.

As a postdoctoral researcher in Human Work Science, you will join a research group in a dynamic research environment that works closely with industry and universities worldwide. Human Work Science at Luleå University of Technology was established in 1974 and currently has 24 employees who conduct research and teaching in both social and technical fields. Our research is highly interdisciplinary, with close collaboration between engineers and social scientists. It is often needs-driven, conducted in close proximity to workplaces and carried out in collaboration with stakeholders in wider society, including manufacturing and service companies, the social partners, and other organisations and actors in the private, public and non-profit sectors. Our projects cover areas such as industry (mining, forestry, steel and construction), health and medical care, education and retail. Organisationally, Human Work Science is part of the Division of Human and Technology, within the Department of Social Sciences, Technology and Arts at Luleå University of Technology. More information is available on our website: www.ltu.se/arbetsvetenskap.

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will have excellent opportunities over two years to develop your academic qualifications in our research subject, primarily through research but also through teaching.



Subject description

Human Work Science includes research on work environment, technology and production systems, work organization, and/or other social processes from humans' conditions and needs in order to create safe and attractive work and socially sustainable development in working life, industry and society.



Project description

As a postdoctoral researcher in Human Work Science, you will primarily work in a research project that aims to develop new knowledge about how AR can support work in underground mines. The project aims to develop and implement Augmented Reality (AR)-based maintenance support for drill rigs. Its objective is to optimise human-technology interaction to improve the efficiency, safety and precision of maintenance processes in the mining industry. The project integrates advanced AR technology with comprehensive change-management strategies and user-centred UX work to support successful implementation and adoption. By combining Epiroc's technical expertise, Boliden's operational experience and academic research, the project seeks to create a solution that is not only technically innovative but also practically useful and well received by maintenance personnel. The work focuses on identifying critical information, optimising how maintenance instructions and training materials are presented, and determining key parameters for improved maintenance. The expected outcomes are more efficient maintenance processes, improved safety, fewer operational disruptions and a better user experience, contributing in turn to greater sustainability and competitiveness in the Swedish mining industry.



Duties

The duties of a postdoctoral researcher primarily involve research. Teaching and educational development may account for no more than 20 per cent of working time. You will participate in and actively contribute to collaboration with national and international partners and with research groups both within and outside Luleå University of Technology. You will also have the opportunity to apply for external research funding.



Qualifications

In order to be eligible for employment as postdoctoral researcher you must have a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in Human Work Science or a closely related research field. A doctoral degree awarded no more than three years before the application deadline provides a useful qualification. Candidates who have been awarded a doctoral degree at an earlier date may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example, different types of statutory leave of absence.

We would also welcome applicants who have

    very good knowledge of both qualitative and quantitative methods
    experience of independently applying for competitive research funding
    experience of leading projects or working groups

Good oral and written communication skills in Swedish or English are required.

Considerable weight will also be given to personal suitability. Desirable personal qualities include good collaboration skills, initiative, an interest in development work, and the ability and motivation to pursue an academic career.



Information

This is a full-time position for two years with the possibility of extension for up to three years, based in Luleå. The intended starting date is 1 November 2026.

For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.

title: Head of European Outbound Logistics
description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

The Supply Chain function drives Volvo Cars’ end-to-end business by planning and delivering a high-performing, strategic supply chain that aligns with the company’s goals of profitability, sustainability, and customer satisfaction.







Outbound Logistics EMEA and Intercontinental encompasses both global and regional responsibilities. Our mission is to manage logistics operations between all regions  (IC) and within Europe—from import ports and European production plants to dealerships.We design and operate a sustainable and resilient distribution network, focusing on cost efficiency and greenhouse gas reduction through responsible sourcing. We drive transformation projects to enhance future excellence in both systems and processes.









     What you'll do  

The Head of European Outbound Logistics is accountable for leading the end-to-end outbound logistics organisation across Europe, ensuring that finished vehicles or products are delivered to customers, markets, retailers, and onward distribution points with the right balance of service performance, cost efficiency, resilience, sustainability, and quality. The role reports to the Global Head of Supply Chain and acts as the regional owner for outbound logistics execution, capability development, and transformation across the European network.







You are to define and execute the European outbound logistics strategy in alignment with the global supply chain strategy, commercial priorities, manufacturing plans, and customer promise. You will own regional outbound logistics performance across service, quality, cost, lead time, capacity, sustainability, and resilience.







You will lead operational governance with transport providers, compounds, ports, terminals, hubs, and other logistics partners, ensuring clear accountability, corrective actions, and continuous improvement. You will also build a high-performing organisation with clear roles, succession planning, capability development, and strong leadership routines across the four organisational pillars.







You will secure capacity and readiness for volume changes, launches, seasonal peaks, market shifts, and disruption scenarios. You are to drive structural cost improvements through network optimisation, carrier strategy, productivity, tender support, improved utilisation, and reduction of premium or avoidable transport costs.







You are to ensure robust escalation management for service failures, capacity constraints, quality deviations, system issues, and major network disruptions. You will lead the digital and data agenda for European outbound logistics, improving visibility, decision quality, automation, and performance management. You will also embed sustainability into transport decisions, including modal shift opportunities, emissions reduction, capacity efficiency, and supplier performance expectations.







You will represent European outbound logistics in global supply chain forums, executive reviews, cross-functional governance, and transformation programmes.









     What you'll bring  

You would bring significant senior leadership experience in outbound logistics, transport operations, distribution, supply chain, or finished goods logistics, preferably in a pan-European or global environment.







This role requires previous experience and a track record in both closely communicating (i.e. Mandarin language proficiency) and working with Stakeholders in China. You are fluent in English communication skills; additional European languages are an advantage. Volvo Cars working experience is also of meritorious.







You bring proven experience leading multi-disciplinary teams and managing through managers, specialists, and operational leads. You bring strong understanding of road transport operations, intercontinental logistics flows, carrier management, logistics engineering, and transport management systems. You have demonstrated ability to lead transformation, network optimisation, digitalisation, cost improvement, and operational performance recovery. You also bring strong commercial understanding, including logistics cost drivers, tendering, supplier governance, contract performance, and budget ownership.







You are highly analytical capability with the ability to translate data into decisions, priorities, and executive-level recommendations. You have excellent stakeholder management skills across senior leadership, markets, manufacturing, procurement, finance, IT, and external partners.







You would bring key leadership skills by providing visible, calm, and fact-based leadership in a complex regional logistics environment. You balance strategic transformation with strong operational discipline and daily execution control. Create clarity across functions, geographies, and partners by setting priorities, decision rights, and performance expectations. Develop leaders and specialists who can manage complexity, challenge performance, and drive improvement with confidence. Act as a trusted regional counterpart to global supply chain leadership, translating business needs into practical logistics solutions.

title: Small Animal Veterinarian with Focus on Anaesthesiology
description:
Department of Clinical Sciences

The University Animal Hospital (UDS) at the Department of Clinical Sciences (KV), serves as SLU's centre for clinical research and education. At UDS, veterinary students, veterinarians, and veterinary nurses receive hands-on training, while clinical research is actively conducted. The management team promotes a forward-thinking and supportive environment, encouraging employees to develop their skills and pursue their interests through ongoing professional development. Benefits include a wellness allowance and a standard 39-hour work week.

We are now seeking a clinically active veterinarian with broad experience in small animal practise and anaesthesiology. Welcome with your application!

About the position

Your primary responsibilities will include responsibility for patients and patient safety in the daily clinical work and supervising students in anaesthesia and analgesia within the university clinics. Participation in the out-of-hours service is also expected.

In your day-to-day role, you will be actively involved in the clinical teaching of veterinary students, interns, and residents. You will also provide guidance and support to veterinary nurses.

Opportunities to engage in ongoing clinical research are available, and you may also contribute to lecturing, small group teaching, and assessing veterinary students. A crucial aspect of your work will involve advising and collaborating with veterinarians in other disciplines, such as intensive care and in patient care. Regular consultations with veterinarians, including referral veterinarians, are an integral part of this role.

Your profile

You have veterinary credentials from a university in Sweden or another EU/EEA country or in Switzerland and is eligible to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden.

It is a merit, but not a requirement, if you hold credentials as an EBVS® European Veterinary Specialist in Veterinary Anaesthesia and Analgesia (or ACVAA board-certified specialist). Teaching and/or research experience in the field is considered merits.

Proficiency in English is required, and you either speak a Scandinavian language or are committed to learning Swedish within a time-period of ca 2-3 years.

Significant emphasis will be placed on personal qualities. We value a professional approach and expect you to be flexible, appreciate teamwork, and contribute to the smooth operation of the surgical department.

About us

The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities within all these fields encompass all animal species.

At the SLU University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate tomorrow’s veterinarians and veterinary nurses and provide first-class care for companion animals, competition animals and production animals. We also share knowledge with the general public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are developing the veterinary care of the future.

Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern, purpose-built facilities, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging and a specialist veterinary laboratory.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Uppsala, Sweden

Form of employment:

Permanent employment. SLU may use probationary employment.

Scope:

100%

As soon as possible according to the agreement.

The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. title: Research Engineer in Analytical Chemistry and Metabolomics
description:
Do you enjoy hands-on analytical chemistry and working with advanced mass spectrometry? At Chalmers Mass Spectrometry Infrastructure (CMSI), you will contribute to a wide range of life science research projects by performing high-quality targeted and untargeted metabolomics analyses. This is a hands-on laboratory role for an analytical chemist who enjoys working systematically, maintaining high quality standards and contributing as part of a collaborative infrastructure team.

Information about the division/project

Chalmers Mass Spectrometry Infrastructure (CMSI) is part of the Division of Infrastructures at the Department of Life Sciences, Chalmers University of Technology. CMSI provides advanced mass spectrometry-based analytical services and expertise, with a particular focus on metabolomics and lipidomics.

We support research projects from academia, healthcare and industry and offer both targeted quantitative metabolomics and untargeted metabolomics workflows. CMSI is also part of the national Metabolomics and Exposomics Platform within SciLifeLab. You will join a team with complementary expertise in analytical chemistry, mass spectrometry, metabolomics and data analysis.

You will conllaborate with researchers and users from a broad range of disciplines and contribute analyses that support cutting-egde research.

Job Description

Your main responsibility will be to perform high-quality analytical work using established targeted and untargeted metabolomics workflows at CMSI. Your tasks will include: •Sample preparation for targeted and untargeted metabolomics analyses.•LC-MS analysis using established CMSI workflows.•Operation and monitoring of LC-MS/MS and LC-HRMS instrumentation.•Routine quality control and assessment of analytical performance.•Documentation of laboratory work and analytical results.•Contribution to instrument maintenance, troubleshooting, SOPs and quality documentation.•General laboratory activities required for reliable and efficient operation of the infrastructure.•Close collaboration with other CMSI staff in the execution of analytical projects.



The focus of the position is on running and ensuring the quality of established analytical workflows. You may also contribute to continuous improvement of existing workflows, while development of new analytical methods is not a primary responsibility of the role.

Contract terms

Temporary employment until 31 October, 2027. Preferable starting date: 1 November, 2026.

Qualifications

We are looking for one-two analytical chemists who enjoy practical laboratory work and have a strong interest in mass spectrometry. The following qualifications are required: •MSc in analytical chemistry, or an equivalent degree with a strong focus on analytical chemistry.•Hands-on experience of LC-MS-based analytical work.•Practical experience of sample preparation and instrumental analysis.•Good understanding of chromatography and mass spectrometry.•Ability to independently perform and document laboratory work.•Good written and spoken English. The following qualifications are considered meritorious: •Experience in targeted and/or untargeted metabolomics.•Experience with UHPLC-MS/MS and/or UHPLC-HRMS systems.•Experience of independently operating and troubleshooting LC-MS instrumentation.•Experience in quantitative bioanalysis.•Experience in systematic quality assurance work, including SOPs and analytical documentation.•Experience of working with large sample series.•Experience from a research infrastructure, core facility or other service-oriented analytical laboratory.•PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related field. You are quality-conscious, systematic and structured, and and enjoy working carefully and reproducibly according to established quality procedures. You are able to work independently while also collaborating closely with colleagues and contributing to common priorities within the team. As CMSI is a research infrastructure supporting many different projects and users, we also value a service-oriented approach and good problem-solving skills.

What we offer

Chalmers provides a cultivating and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg.



Read more about working at Chalmers and our benefits for employees.





Chalmers aims to actively improve our gender balance. We work broadly with equality projects, for example the GENIE Initiative on gender equality for excellence. Equality and diversity are substantial foundations in all activities at Chalmers.

CV

title: Production Support Engineer
description:
When you can’t breathe, nothing else matters. That’s why a career at Breas Medical matters.

Our mission is to improve the quality of life and care of respiratory patients around the world through a personal commitment to innovation, quality and customer focus.

Are you our next Production Support Engineer?

Are you an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and turning ideas into reliable manufacturing solutions? You may already have experience in production or manufacturing engineering, or you may be at the beginning of your career with a relevant technical education and an interest in medical technology.

As a Production Support Engineer within R&D Sweden, you will play an important role in strengthening our production processes and supporting the introduction of new products and design changes. Working closely with Production, R&D, Quality and other cross-functional teams, you will help ensure that our products are manufactured safely, efficiently and in accordance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements.

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on production support with continuous improvement, technical problem-solving and long-term development in a highly regulated and meaningful industry.

The position is full-time, permanent and based on-site at Breas Medical’s headquarters in Mölnlycke, Sweden.

Main responsibilities

    

Provide technical support to Production and help resolve manufacturing and quality-related issues.

    

Lead or support design transfers, new product introductions and the implementation of design changes.

    

Develop and improve manufacturing processes, methods, tooling, equipment and work instructions.

    

Plan, perform and document process, verification and validation activities.

    

Analyse production performance and contribute to improvements in product quality, production yield, safety and cost efficiency.

    

Support Lean initiatives and collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals.

About you

You are a curious and solutions-oriented engineer who enjoys turning technical challenges into practical improvements. You work in a structured way, with attention to quality, safety and documentation.

Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you are comfortable communicating with colleagues across different functions and areas of expertise. You have an open mindset, enjoy working close to production and are motivated by contributing to products and processes that make a meaningful difference.

To be successful in this role, we believe you bring some of the following experience and skills:

    

A university degree in production engineering, medical engineering, mechanical engineering, electronics or another relevant technical field.

    

Experience or a strong interest in production, manufacturing processes or medical technology.

    

An understanding of mechanics, electronics and software, and how these areas interact within a product.

    

Experience or knowledge of Design for Manufacturing, design transfer, verification, validation, tooling or process development.

    

A structured approach to problem-solving and technical documentation.

    

Good spoken and written Swedish and English.

Previous experience in production or manufacturing engineering is an advantage but not essential. We also welcome applications from recent graduates with a relevant educational background and an interest in developing within production engineering and medical technology.

Knowledge of regulatory requirements and standards for medical devices, such as ISO 13485, MDR, IEC 60601-1 or FDA requirements, is considered an advantage.

Be More with us

Join Breas and become part of a company where your experience, ideas and ambition can make a meaningful difference. Apply today and explore what it means to Be More.

Expected recruitment timeline

Applications will be reviewed continuously.

More about us

Founded in 1991 in Gothenburg, Sweden, Breas Medical is a global specialist in home mechanical ventilation and airway clearance, with a growing portfolio of sleep therapy solutions.

Our purpose is to help the world breathe better. We connect people throughout the respiratory journey by bringing together insights, innovation and care. Our solutions form a connected ecosystem that includes ventilation, airway clearance, interfaces, accessories, connectivity, services and clinical education, supporting patients, caregivers and healthcare professionals from therapy initiation to long-term care at home.

Headquartered in Sweden, Breas has more than 300 employees and subsidiaries across Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. Together with our network of specialised distributors, we serve customers in over 40 countries worldwide.

Breas Medical

title: Mekanikkonstruktör

Hos oss blir du en del av ett växande team där vi värdesätter teknisk nyfikenhet, samarbete och långsiktig kompetensutveckling.

Kulturen på Multiply bygger på tre grundpelare: karaktär, engagemang och kompetens. Hur du tar ansvar, samarbetar och utvecklas är minst lika viktigt som din tekniska bakgrund.

I slutändan handlar Multiply om att kombinera tre saker:

title: SSAB - Design Specialist
description:
Are you passionate about engineering, product development, and innovative vehicle design? We are looking for a Design Specialist to join the expert team at SSAB Knowledge Service Center.

SSAB is a globally recognized leader in advanced high-strength steels, helping automotive manufacturers build safer, lighter, and more sustainable vehicles. In this role, you will work at the intersection of materials technology, structural analysis, and forming simulation to support the development of next-generation automotive solutions.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, collaborating with customers, and using advanced simulation tools to turn innovative concepts into robust, manufacturable products.

We are seeking an experienced engineering professional with strong analytical skills, deep technical expertise, and a genuine interest in product development, structural analysis, and sheet metal forming. Location: Borlänge

Becoming part of the SSAB family means joining a journey. A journey that we believe is essential for the sustainability of this planet. Steel has been one of the most important materials for developing our society and it will continue to be so. In the roofs over our heads, in the bridges connecting our cities and in the cars of tomorrow. At SSAB we are proud of our history and leadership in high-strength steel. But we are also aware that the production of steel is one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases in the world. That has to change. That is why we have developed the world’s ﬁrst fossil free steel production and has committed to becoming largely fossil-free. As part of SSAB you will be instrumental in realizing this goal and push for the green transformation of the whole steel industry.

About the position 

As a Design Specialist, you will provide expert guidance on structural performance, forming feasibility, simulation methods, material behavior, and application development. Your expertise will help customers optimize components and structures for performance, manufacturability, and sustainability using SSAB’s portfolio of advanced steel grades.

You will focus on the mobility segment, developing conceptual designs, evaluating structural performance, and predicting manufacturing outcomes, often in close collaboration with vehicle manufacturers.

Your daily work will include structural analyses, forming simulations, material data evaluation, method development, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing.

You will join a highly skilled team of steel experts who combine deep technical expertise with strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.  

Main responsibilities

    Develop design concepts that illustrate the benifits and applications of advanced steel grades
    Collaborate with automotive customers in designing and optimizing components and body structures  
    Perform structural analyses using finite element methods (FEM) to assess structural performance and lightweighting possibilities
    Conduct forming simulations to evaluate manufacturability and process robustness
    Develop and validate simulation methodologies, material models, and engineering workflows
    Provide customers and colleagues with technical expertise in structural performance, forming processes, material behavior, and design optimization
    Develop and deliver technical training, workshops, seminars, and presentations tailored to customers and business needs



About you

    A master’s degree or higher in mechanical engineering, materials engineering, engineering physics, vehicle engineering, or a related field
    At least five years of experience in the automotive, manufacturing, or engineering industry
    Solid knowledge of and experience in structural analysis and/or sheet metal forming simulation.  
    Experience using CAE tools such as LS-DYNA, Abaqus, ANSYS, AutoForm, or PAM-STAMP
    Excellent written and spoken English



To thrive and succeed in this role, you should also:

    Communicate clearly and build strong working relationships
    Enjoy solving complex technical challenges and finding practical solutions
    See the big picture and connect technical details to broader business needs
    Contribute as a collaborative team player  



It is an advantage if you have:

    Experience in automotive product development, body-in-white engineering, crash analysis, durability, or lightweight design
    Knowledge of advanced high-strength steels and their use in automotive structures
    Knowledge of Swedish and a strong ambition to become fluent

Our offer

We offer a range of valued employee benefits, including:

    Profit sharing
    Improved work-life balance through reduced working hours
    Wellness grants

Recruitment process 

    Application
    Assessments
    Interview
    Reference check
    Health examination
    Offer and contract signing

A background check may form part of the recruitment process. The health examination includes drug testing.

title: Linux System Administrator - 19618
description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Role Summary

An experienced Linux System Administrator is needed for a consulting assignment focused on designing, building and maintaining a GPU-enabled remote desktop and virtual desktop infrastructure environment. The platform supports high-performance remote desktops for pre-processing and post-processing of High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads, including simulation, visualization and rendering.

The environment is based on Rocky Linux and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), with technologies including X11, Xfce4, NICE DCV, EnginFrame and SLURM. The assignment has a strong emphasis on automation, platform engineering, system architecture and long-term operational sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

    Design, deploy, operate and maintain a Linux-based GPU-enabled VDI and remote desktop environment.
    Develop and maintain automation and Infrastructure-as-Code solutions to enable consistent, repeatable platform deployments.
    Use Ansible primarily to automate configuration management, provisioning and operational workflows.
    Ensure that the platform remains secure, scalable, high-performing and maintainable over time.
    Support remote desktop use cases for HPC-related simulation, visualization and rendering workloads.
    Collaborate closely with HPC and infrastructure engineering teams on platform design, integration and operations.
    Document solution architecture, system configurations, deployment workflows and operational procedures.
    Contribute to monitoring, observability and troubleshooting of complex Linux infrastructure environments.

Technical Stack & Requirements

    Rocky Linux and/or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
    Ansible and Infrastructure-as-Code practices for automated deployments and configuration management.
    Bash scripting; Python is advantageous.
    Git and GitLab, including experience working with CI/CD pipelines.
    X11 and Linux desktop environments, particularly Xfce4 and GNOME.
    Remote rendering, display and visualization technologies, including NICE DCV and EnginFrame.
    Networking, infrastructure security and monitoring capabilities.
    Prometheus-based monitoring and observability tooling.
    HPC environments and the SLURM workload manager are advantageous.
    Docker, Podman and Open OnDemand are beneficial.

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal consultant has solid hands-on experience as a Linux System Administrator, preferably in Rocky Linux or RHEL environments. Strong experience in automation and Infrastructure-as-Code is required, ideally with Ansible or comparable tooling. The role requires proficiency in Bash scripting, while Python experience is considered beneficial.

Experience with CI/CD practices, version control, Linux graphical environments, remote display technologies, networking, security and monitoring is expected. The consultant should be capable of designing scalable, maintainable technical platforms and independently taking ownership of complex infrastructure environments. Experience supporting HPC platforms, SLURM, remote visualization solutions and container technologies is considered advantageous.
