title: Automotive Design & Development Engineer
description:
The Automotive Design & Development Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing, and validation of automotive components and systems in accordance with international automotive standards and Swedish industry practices. The role involves technical responsibility from concept phase through series production.

The position requires advanced engineering competence and independent technical decision-making.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

The employee will perform the following tasks:

Design & Development

    •    Develop and design automotive components and subsystems using CAD software (e.g., CATIA, Siemens NX, Creo, SolidWorks).

    •    Prepare 2D drawings and 3D models including GD&T specifications.

    •    Conduct tolerance analysis and material selection.

    •    Lead concept design reviews and technical feasibility studies.

Engineering Analysis & Validation

    •    Perform engineering simulations such as FEA and CFD.

    •    Support prototype builds and validation testing.

    •    Prepare Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R).

    •    Conduct DFMEA and risk assessments.

Product Lifecycle Management

    •    Manage engineering change requests (ECR/ECN).

    •    Prepare technical documentation in compliance with automotive quality standards (IATF 16949, ISO standards).

    •    Coordinate with manufacturing for production readiness.

Supplier & Cross-Functional Coordination

    •    Interface with suppliers for component development and cost optimization.

    •    Support procurement and quality teams during APQP and PPAP processes.

    •    Provide technical support during vehicle launch and production ramp-up.

Qualification Requirements

The position requires:

    •    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or equivalent.

    •    Experience in engineering simulations (FEA/CFD preferred).

    •    Fluent English (spoken and written).

The position requires independent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in cross-functional international teams.

Employment Terms

    •    Employment type: Full-time, Project based

    •    Working hours: 40 hours per week

    •    Salary: Salary in line with Swedish collective agreement and meeting the minimum salary requirement for work permit eligibility

    •    Benefits: Occupational pension, insurance, and employment conditions according to Swedish labor law and applicable collective agreement

5. Level of Responsibility

This role is classified as a qualified engineering position requiring higher education and specialized technical competence. The employee will independently manage assigned development projects and contribute to technical decision-making.

title: HEAD OF TECHNICAL OPERATIONS AND NP CAMO
description:
Company description:

Scandinavian Airlines System SAS

Job description:  Description  

Do you want to lead the continuing airworthiness function for one of Scandinavia’s largest airline fleets?As Head of Technical Operations and NP CAMO, you will hold the regulatory responsibility for ensuring the airworthiness, safety, compliance, and cost-effective operation of the SAS fleet. Reporting directly to the Accountable Manager, you will lead the CAMO organization and play a critical role in ensuring that all continuing airworthiness activities are conducted in accordance with EASA regulations, company requirements, and operational objectives.This is a senior leadership role with significant operational, regulatory, organizational, and strategic responsibility.

     Challenges you will work on:  

•    Regulatory responsibility for airworthy, safe and economical operation of SAS's aircraft fleet under the limitation of the requirements imposed by European aviation regulations in accordance with EASA Part-CAMO and EASA Air Operations regulation.Main Tasks•    Ensure the development, updating and approval of the fleet's maintenance programs.•    Ensure that all maintenance requirements from manufacturers and authorities are evaluated, implemented and accomplished within the applicable compliance limits.•    Ensure the provision and preparation of approved documentation for all maintenance, repairs and modifications carried out on the aircraft fleet.•    Ensure that the aircraft with continuing airworthiness and approved configuration of the fleet are maintained in accordance with EASA Part-CAMO and Part-M, as applicable, and EASA Air Operations requirements, and that records are kept showing the airworthiness status.•    Ensure that all maintenance, including line maintenance and base maintenance, is planned and executed within the deadlines prescribed in the individual aircraft type maintenance programs and applicable maintenance programme limitations, approved maintenance data, and aircraft technical log requirements.•    Ensure that technical services for aircraft, engines and components are contracted in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, as well as SAS's operational and commercial requirements.•    Ensure the proper storage and management of flight documentation.•    Ensure that SAS's overall maintenance needs are carried out on competitive terms.•    Ensure that continuing airworthiness activities are performed in accordance with applicable requirements, approved procedures, and AOC conditions and limitations, and that aircraft airworthiness and regulatory compliance are maintained.•    Ensure hazards, occurrences, and non-compliances are identified, assessed, and addressed, and that appropriate corrective actions are implemented.•    Ensure clear lines of responsibility and escalation are established and maintained and shall, within the scope of delegated authority, assess and escalate risks affecting airworthiness to the Accountable Manager or other authorized decision-making level, as applicable.Managerial Responsibility and Mandate•    Legal and organizational responsibility for the tasks within Continuing Airworthiness Management.•    Personnel responsibility for all CAMO personnel, with direct leadership responsibility for the management team.•    Delegated budget responsibility for the operation of Technical Operations within SAS CAMO.•    Member of the Accountable Manager management team and contributor to achieving and developing company goals and objectives.

     The Team  

Continuing Airworthiness Management constitutes a key function within SAS operations and requires extensive collaboration across the organization.The role works closely with operational functions throughout SAS and maintains strong relationships with aircraft, engine and equipment manufacturers, maintenance providers, suppliers, and aviation authorities.As Head of Technical Operations and NP CAMO, you will lead the CAMO organization and its management team while supporting a culture focused on safety, compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

     To be successful we believe you have  

Key Competencies•    Extensive experience within Continuing Airworthiness Management and aviation technical operations. •    Strong knowledge of EASA Part-CAMO, Part-M, Part-145, and Air Operations requirements. •    Experience leading technical and operational teams in a complex, regulated environment. •    A relevant university degree in Engineering, Aviation Management, or a related field. •    Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills. •    Experience working with aviation authorities, aircraft manufacturers, and maintenance organizations. •    The ability to balance safety, compliance, operational performance, and commercial objectives. A strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach to leadership and execution.



In addition, we believe you are:•    A strong and inspiring leader with excellent stakeholder management skills.•    Comfortable operating in a highly regulated and complex operational environment.•    Strategic while maintaining a strong operational focus.•    Decisive and able to make informed decisions balancing safety, compliance, operational needs, and business objectives.•    A strong communicator who builds trust and collaboration across functions and organizations.•    Structured, accountable, and committed to maintaining the highest safety and compliance standards.

title: Olsaro is looking to hire a CTO
description:
Are you a visionary technology leader with a passion for transforming agriculture through science?

Are you driven to lead R&D innovation at the intersection of biotechnology, sustainability, and food security?

OlsAro Crop Biotech is looking for a dynamic Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to guide our growing team and technical vision as we tackle one of the greatest challenges of our time: feeding the world in a changing climate.

About Us

We are Olsaro Crop Biotech, a pioneering trait development and pre-breeding startup dedicated to developing solutions that empower agriculture to withstand a changing climate. Our focus is on enhancing crop resilience through innovative genetic materials, with the first focus on wheat. From tackling abiotic stresses like salinity and heat to improving nitrogen use efficiency, we are at the forefront of trait development innovation to support resilience and global food security. Having closed a successful seed funding round, we are scaling our efforts both technologically and commercially, aiming for food system resilience for future generations.

The Role: Chief Technology Officer

As our CTO, you will bring a strong background in trait development and the seed industry, taking on a central role in OlsAro’s technology journey. You will lead the R&D team, shape our platform strategy, and drive innovation across trait discovery and variety development. Reporting directly to the CEO and serving as a key member of the senior leadership team, you will have full ownership of the technology roadmap and its execution. This is a highly empowered role with significant influence over both strategic direction and day-to-day decision-making. You will work alongside the CSO as a peer. The CSO, will be responsible for advising technical expertise and setting longer term strategy as a co-founder/C-suite leader.

Your expertise will enable the rapid evelopment and scale-up of breakthrough biotech solutions, working closely with internal teams, external partners, and strategic investors.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute OlsAro’s long-term vision in trait development for cereals.

• Oversee platform development and trait development pipelines from concept to field.

• Lead, inspire, develop and expand our interdisciplinary R&D team.

• Oversee timely, budget-conscious project delivery, while managing resources effectively.

• Forge and manage high-impact collaborations with seed industry and research partners.

• Secure and manage public funding opportunities to support strategic partnerships and R&D initiatives, enabling innovation and long-term growth.

• Build data-driven infrastructure and oversee bioinformatics development.

• Integrate emerging technologies such as gene editing, molecular breeding, and AI-powered trait discovery.

• Represent OlsAro in customer, scientific, regulatory, and investment communities.

• Ensure high standards for reproducibility, data integrity, and regulatory compliance.

Required Qualifications

• Proven leadership experience (7+ years) in technology and R&D roles within agtech, preferably seed industry. Including a strong ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage complex projects.

• Ph.D. or equivalent experience in Molecular Biology, Plant Biotechnology, Computational Biology, or related field.

• Experience working in commercial trait development, breeding in a seed or trait development company.

• Proven skills in representing an organization in different communities and contexts, including driving the OlsAro tech-agenda in commercial dialogs.

• Demonstrated expertise in publicly presenting tech-driven business cases and taking part in discussions at business conferences and in scientific communities.

• Proven track record of attracting public funding for R&D and partnerships.

• Experience in trait development methodologies, molecular techniques, data integration, phenomics, and data management tools.

• Strategic thinker with excellent problem-solving, communication, and decisionmaking skills.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on approach to building systems in a fastpaced startup environment.

• In-depth understanding of regulatory pathways for the commercialization of seeds and traits.

• Expertise in intellectual property development, technology licensing and scaling R&D and product platforms, preferably within startup or early-stage environments.

• Fluent in English.

Join Us

If you are a visionary technology leader with a passion for transforming agriculture through science, then we invite you to join our journey to revolutionize crop development and to contribute to our mission of advancing climate adaptation in cereals.

Position Details

• Type: Full-time, permanent

• Start Date: From 15th of October 2026 (flexible based on candidate availability)

• Location: Gothenburg, Sweden (Medicinaregatan 9C). Physical attendance is mandatory.

• Applications will be evaluated continuously.

How to apply

Please provide your CV and cover letter outlining your qualifications and relevant experience.

Why Join OlsAro in Gothenburg, Sweden?

• Gothenburg is Sweden’s dynamic innovation hub, where world-class universities, cutting-edge startups, and a fast-growing life sciences sector come together in a vibrant, forward-looking city. Beyond its strong professional opportunities, it consistently ranks among Europe’s most livable cities, offering an exceptional quality of life, outstanding healthcare, and a well-functioning social support system. With its welcoming atmosphere, lively cultural scene, cozy cafés, coastal charm, and easy access to Sweden’s beautiful natural parcs. Enjoy the balance of urban culture and nature—with coastlines, archipelagos, forests, and hiking trails at your doorstep.

• Gothenburg is an English-friendly city, with an international community and vibrant tech and research scene

• Sweden offers a high-quality, tuition-free public education system from preschool to university. International and bilingual schools are available in Gothenburg. Sweden consistently ranks highly in international education assessments such as the Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study (TIMSS), reflecting the strong academic foundation provided by the Swedish school system.

• Sweden is a leader in sustainability, gender equality, and family-friendly policies, making it an ideal place to build both a career and a life.

title: Trade & Customs Associate

description:
Om rollen

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

title: Strategic Account Manager | AstraZeneca | Lernia
description:
Zeneca Nordic Marketing Company employs around 550 people and has offices located in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo, and Espoo. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. As a Strategic Account Manager at AstraZeneca in Sweden, you will play a pivotal role in transforming care projects and seeking out local and regional business opportunities. Providing value propositions aligned with stakeholder needs and objectives is essential, ultimately driving greater adherence to guideline-directed medical therapies.

Your role will involve developing and implementing local brand operational plans through cross-functional teamwork, collecting and consolidating customer insights, and informing account plans for the brand/franchise strategy.

This is a field-based position and covers the areas Värmland, Örebro, Stockholm, Södermanland and Dalarna.

We welcome new candidates that match the requirements and live in one of following regions (Stockholm, Uppsala, Örebro, Södermanland, Värmland or Västmanland).

Collaboration is key, requiring close work with the local brand team to develop tailored strategies for each account and stakeholder. Efforts will be crucial in achieving favourable brand listings, protocol inclusion, and increased brand usage through effective OMNI channel plan delivery. Leveraging data analytics, market research, and customer insights, you will identify growth opportunities and utilize tools like Veeva to track customer interactions and forecast sales. Your ability to provide value-based selling by highlighting the clinical, economic, and patient outcomes of AstraZeneca's products will be essential. Building and maintaining strategic partnerships within the therapeutic area ecosystem is a vital part of your role.

Staying informed on industry trends, market dynamics, and healthcare policies is crucial to ensure AstraZeneca remains at the forefront of the market.

Essential Skills:

    

Living in any of these regions: Stockholm, Uppsala, Örebro, Södermanland, Värmland or Västmanland and a Valid driver’s license is a requirement

    

Academic degree or equivalent in Business or Healthcare and minimum 3 years in healthcare sectors or pharmaceutical industry and strong understanding of the healthcare system, pharma industry, and health economics.

title: Service Delivery Specialist
description:
Join us to deliver a smoke- free future as Service Delivery Specialist!

We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and have been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

In our Service Delivery Team, we have the mission to handle the entire fulfillment flow to market and the distribution to its customers and consumers in order to fulfill internal and external customers’ expectations and align with all laws and regulations. As a Service Delivery Specialist, you will drive all outbound activities from the Logistics Service Provider (LSP) towards consumers. You will collaborate closely with key counterparts both locally and internationally, maintaining a focus on your customers. Additionally, you will cooperate in future-shaping projects both at a local and EU level.



Your day-to-day:

    Monitoring shipments from the factory to the LSP for the Nordic markets.
    Managing customer and B2C forward orders and their deliveries and reverse flows; guaranteeing cost-efficient and timely fulfillment and reverse process to market and its customers/consumers.
    Managing relationships with LSPs, contract conditions, ensuring compliance with audit and internal billing guidelines, and participating in tender processes with Procurement.
    Regular monitoring of Track and Trace reporting and compliance.
    Looking for process improvements, productivities, and sustainability initiatives.
    Customer collaboration activities such as analyzing order patterns and improving the return process.
    Developing procedures for logistics processes such as stock counts and destructions.
    Shaping the logistics landscape to deliver our transformation towards a smoke-free future.



Who we’re looking for:

    2-3 years of experience in the field of supply chain in an internationally operating (FMCG) company.
    Knowledgeable and passionate about the Logistics, Sales & Distribution environment.
    Advanced knowledge of MS Office (SAP knowledge is a plus).
    Proficiency in English with good general communication skills.



Key Competencies:

    You are a problem solver and versatile.
    You are resilient in a dynamically changing environment.
    You have a high team orientation but are also able to work independently.
    You are open and courageous for new things and have the will to optimize.
    You are able to quickly establish excellent contacts with our internal and external customers.
    You have a high degree of analytical and learning capabilities, including a high level of quality of work.



All applicants must have the legal right to work in Sweden. Relocation support is not available for this job.



What we offer:



Join Swedish Match and you too can:



    Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment, and explore.
    Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.
    Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.
    Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provide endless opportunities to progress.
    Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.

title: Personalansvarig Housekeeping Stockholm
description:

drivs av att utveckla människor och skapa goda kundrelationer

    

har ett affärsmässigt förhållningssätt och god ekonomisk förståelse

    

är van att planera, prioritera och fatta beslut i ett högt tempo

    

har kunskap inom personalledning och arbetsrätt

    

kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

    

har B-körkort

Hos oss får du fortsätta arbeta i hotellbranschen – men med möjlighet att påverka fler verksamheter och utvecklas i en affärsnära ledarroll.

Vi erbjuder bland annat:

    

stort eget ansvar och korta beslutsvägar

    

ett engagerat team med hög energi

    

ett modernt kontor mitt i Stockholm med gym, restaurang, café och takterrass i huset

    

generösa personalförmåner och kompetensutveckling

    

ett av branschens starkaste nätverk inom hotell och besöksnäring

Ansökan

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Arbetstiderna är huvudsakligen dagtid måndag–fredag, med ett fåtal kvällar och helger per år.

Vill du fortsätta utveckla hotellbranschen – från ett nytt perspektiv? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan!

title: Team Manager - Building Management Systems
description:
Team Manager - Building Management Systems (BMS)





What We Are Looking For



We are currently seeking a highly motivated and inspiring Team Manager to lead the development of Schneider Electric's corporate Building Management System (BMS) platform.



As part of our global R&D organization, you will work closely with Product Management and development teams across multiple locations to drive innovation and deliver next-generation digital building solutions. Our state-of-the-art platform provides the foundational technology that enables customers to optimize building performance, sustainability, and operational efficiency.



This is a unique opportunity to combine people leadership, technical strategy, and product development within one of Schneider Electric's most important digital offerings. It’s an ideal role for an experienced engineering leader who is ready to take on greater organizational impact and position themselves for future senior leadership opportunities.





Your Impact



As Team Manager, you will lead a team responsible for developing software solutions that power the next generation of our BMS platform. You will create an environment where innovation, collaboration, execution and excellence thrive while ensuring the successful delivery of strategic objectives and product roadmaps.



Beyond leading day-to-day operations, you will help shape our engineering organization, influence strategic decisions, and contribute to the long-term development of our people, processes, and technology roadmap.



This position offers a unique opportunity for an ambitious leader who is motivated to broaden their impact, grow their organizational influence, and develop broader leadership responsibilities in the future.





Key Responsibilities




    Lead and develop a high-performing software development team within an agile environment.
    Coach, mentor, and support engineers in their professional growth and career development.
    Drive execution and delivery of product roadmaps while ensuring quality, efficiency, and predictability.
    Collaborate closely with Product Management, Architects, and Engineering teams across a global organization.
    Build strong cross-functional partnerships and facilitate effective communication between teams and stakeholders.
    Foster a customer-centric culture focused on continuous improvement and innovation.
    Promote best practices in software development, including quality assurance, cybersecurity, maintainability, and sustainability.
    Drive the adoption of modern development approaches, tools, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
    Support strategic planning, resource management, and decision-making within the organization.
    Create a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and execution excellence.





Required Skills and Experience




    Minimum 5 years of experience leading software development teams.
    At least 5 years of experience with direct reports.


    Conduct development and performance reviews.
    Set goals and follow up on results.
    Provide feedback and coaching.
    Manage salary review and compensation processes.
    Support employee development and career planning.

  
    Proven track record of building, developing, and motivating high-performing engineering teams.
    Experience delivering complex software products in an agile environment.
    Strong technical foundation with a genuine interest in modern software technologies and emerging trends.
    Experience or demonstrated interest in leveraging AI-assisted development tools and driving engineering productivity improvements.
    Experience developing customer-facing applications with a strong focus on user experience.

    Fluency in both Swedish and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.





What We Offer



This is an exciting opportunity to join Schneider Electric and accelerate your career as a global technology leader.



At Schneider Electric, you'll be part of an international, innovative, and purpose-driven company where sustainability and digital transformation are at the core of everything we do. We invest in our people and empower them to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact every day.



In addition to leading a highly skilled engineering team, this role offers significant opportunities for professional development. As our organization continues to evolve, you will have the chance to expand your leadership scope, increase your strategic influence, and contribute to shaping the future direction of our software organization. This role is particularly well suited for a leader who is eager to continue growing and preparing for broader leadership responsibilities over time.



Join us and help shape the future of smart and sustainable buildings.





About Our Team



The Building Management Systems (BMS) team is a cross-functional organization within Schneider Electric's Buildings business, based in Lund, Sweden.



We develop complete end-to-end solutions, from IoT sensors and controllers to cloud-connected services and modern web applications. Our mission is to help customers create smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable buildings.



We are proud of what we have built, but we are equally passionate about continuous improvement. We constantly explore new technologies, refine our development practices, and encourage learning across the entire team.



Our culture is built on collaboration, trust, ownership, and a shared drive to make both our products and ourselves better every day.

title: Product Deployment Engineer - Search/performace to leading search engine
description:
We are looking for a Product Deployment Engineer – Search to join the Google App team. The ideal candidate has experience as a Performance Marketing Specialist and will work closely with the team on search-related products and performance. This is a consultancy assignment starting as soon as possible, with an initial duration of up to 12 months.

As a Product Deployment Engineer, you manage external clients and/or consult internal teams to exercise your comprehensive knowledge of translating commercial business models/needs into technical solutions. You own and manage relationships with technical and non-technical manager+ level internal and external users/clients/partners/stakeholders and deliver excellent customer care to achieve project goals. You manage project outcomes and are a key contributor, creating custom solutions, repeatable solution development, customer requirement gathering and mapping, and solution strategy, scoping, and development. You possess core technical skills and comprehensive knowledge of troubleshooting, systems design, integration, and our technologies and processes, using it to act as an industry specialist in your technical domain.

Responsibilities include:

    Provide feedback on product requirement documents (PRDs) and design documents; may author or actively drive PRDs, particularly around the developer experience.
    Review product requirement documents (PRDs) to record product specifications, and validate PRDs to ensure customer/partner and internal needs are met.
    Scale existing or create repeatable solutions (e.g., best practices recommendations, tutorials, blog articles, sample code) and ensure effective documentation of repeatable solutions.
    Drive solution code development in collaboration with internal or external developers/users/partners/clients/stakeholders (as needed). Test products/solutions for customers/partners before release through different phases (e.g., internal testing, user acceptance testing). Contribute to resolving bugs and refining product/solutions through feedback collection and iteration.
    Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders in customer and/or partner organizations to deliver or manage quality technical solutions and services.
    Define long-term technical solution strategies in collaboration with cross-functional teams and influence the direction and priority of technical product features and/or the solution.
    Define and identify problems at the system level or from a broader perspective and design a workable solution. Moderate understanding of how factors or components in a system interrelate. Contribute to defining the appropriate components at scale, application programming interfaces (APIs), and data for a given system to meet specific requirements of the user and the ability to validate the system correctness and functionality.
    Leverage, customize, or develop solutions based on defined customer/partner business objectives and technical requirements. Drive discussions with internal teams and users/clients/partners/stakeholders to define solution constraints and scope. Help identify the value of solutions through design sessions with the customer/partner.
    Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in their respective process lifecycle to provide technical guidance or identify possible existing or new technical solution offerings to help shape outcomes. Contribute to indirectly engaging customers and internal teams as part of the process lifecycle.
    Troubleshoot complex technical issues throughout solution delivery and deployment by generating and analyzing relevant data, proposing fixes, and validating solutions.

Skills Required
As a Product Deployment Engineer (Search), you will serve as a strategic technical authority driving customer adoption, performance, and speed to market for Google’s largest advertisers across diverse industry verticals. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, navigating complex ad tech architectures to design, deploy, and scale advanced Google Search and AI-driven advertising solutions.
In this role, you will bridge the gap between commercial strategy and deep technical execution. Working closely with cross-functional sales and product teams, you will deploy cutting-edge Search features—including AI Max for Search, Smart Bidding, advanced data integrations, and feed solutions—ensuring our partners achieve sustainable business growth.

Minimum role qualifications require proficiency in:

    Opportunity and pipeline management
    Industry knowledge
    Situational leadership
    Debugging and troubleshooting
    Stakeholder management strategy
    Systems Thinking (Knowledge)
    Technical acumen
    Core Tech role related knowledge
    System design or Coding
    Team Management
    Consultative skills

title: Destinationschef till First Camp
description:
Vill du leda en destination där gästupplevelser, affärsutveckling och ledarskap går hand i hand? Hos First Camp får du möjlighet att kombinera affärsmässighet, service och ledarskap i en roll med stort ansvar och variation. Här får du driva, utveckla och påverka din destination – med fokus på resultat, gästnöjdhet och teamutveckling – i ett företag som ständigt växer och förändras.

Vilka är First Camp?

Vi är en del av First Camp Group, norra Europas ledande koncern för camping och resorts. Tillsammans är vi på en spännande resa med en tydlig, gemensam vision: att skapa en världsledande campingkedja - där vi är first choice för gäster, medarbetare och campingbranschen i Europa.

Hållbar utveckling och datadrivna gäst- och medarbetarinsikter är viktiga fokusområden för att tillsammans skapa moments of happiness - varje dag.

Vad innebär rollen?

Som Destinationschef får du en roll med stort ansvar, variation och verklig påverkan. Du leder helheten på din destination – människor, drift och resultat – och är navet som får allt att fungera tillsammans. Rollen handlar lika mycket om att skapa ordning och struktur som att bygga engagemang, driva affär och utveckla både verksamheten och medarbetarna.

Du är närvarande i vardagen, ser detaljerna som gör skillnad och fattar beslut nära verksamheten. Samtidigt har du blicken framåt och arbetar långsiktigt för att stärka destinationens lönsamhet, gästupplevelse och teamkultur.

I uppdraget ingår bland annat att:

    

Leda, rekrytera och utveckla medarbetare samt säkerställa bemanning, introduktion och en trygg arbetsmiljö.

    

Driva den dagliga driften effektivt och strukturerat, med fokus på kvalitet, service och gästupplevelse.

    

Ansvara för budget, KPI:er och resultat – inklusive försäljning mot både privat- och företagskunder.

    

Arbeta med affärsutveckling, prissättning och paketering i samverkan med supportkontor och kollegor.

    

Vara synlig i verksamheten och coacha teamet i värdskap, bemötande och service – från första intryck till avresa.

    

Samarbeta med Regionchef och centrala funktioner för att säkra samsyn, struktur och resultat.

Rollen kräver närvaro, engagemang och ett tydligt ledarskap – men också nyfikenhet, initiativkraft och viljan att alltid hitta vägar framåt.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker en driven och affärsorienterad ledare med ett genuint intresse för människor och service. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategi och drift, inspirera andra och skapa både resultat och trivsel.

Med tydlighet, engagemang och helhetsperspektiv leder du din destination mot gemensamma mål – och skapar en miljö där både gäster och medarbetare känner sig välkomna, sedda och stolta.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

    

Erfarenhet av ledarskap och personalansvar, gärna från besöksnäring, service, handel eller hotell.

    

God förståelse för ekonomi, affärsutveckling och försäljning.

    

Förmåga att driva förändring, utveckla team och skapa engagemang.

    

Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.

    

God systemvana och förmåga att arbeta strukturerat även i ett högt tempo.

    

B-körkort och möjlighet att använda destinationens fordon i arbetet.

    

Det är meriterande med erfarenhet av rekrytering, budgetarbete, B2B-försäljning eller lokalt affärssamarbete.

Som person är du en närvarande och trygg ledare med förmåga att fatta beslut nära verksamheten. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder, skapar tydlighet och energi i teamet och driver förbättringar som gör skillnad för både gäster och medarbetare.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Hos oss får du vara en del av ett ambitiöst företag med både hjärta och framåtanda. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att påverka, utvecklas och växa – samtidigt som du får arbeta nära både människor och verksamhet.

Våra gemensamma värderingar styr våra dagliga handlingar:

We Care – Vi jobbar tillsammans med omtanke om gästen, medarbetaren och planeten. Vi skapar en öppen och stöttande miljö där vi utmanar varandra, lär oss av misstag och firar framgångar.

We Have Fun – Genom att vara oss själva och ha roligt ihop skapar vi en välkomnande stämning för alla vi möter. Tillsammans skapar vi fina minnen för våra team, kollegor och gäster.

We Simplify – Framåtanda, tillsammans med viljan att lära, gör att vi ständigt förbättrar och utvecklar hur vi arbetar. Vi gör det enkelt för varandra – det ska vara lätt att göra rätt för både kollegor och våra gäster.

We Deliver Results – Vi fokuserar i allt vi gör på att skapa resultat för våra gäster, kollegor och hela företaget. Målen är högt satta och vi lyckas bäst när vi använder både hjärta och hjärna.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats med goda möjligheter till utveckling och omtänksamma kollegor som delar med sig av visdom och skratt. Tillsammans vill vi fortsätta vår framgångssaga och växa med fler stjärnor som vill vara med och bygga vår framtid.

Villkor

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och innefattas av kollektivavtal med inledande provanställning. Lön och villkor enligt överenskommelse. Arbetet innefattar visst helg- och kvällsarbete samt delad beredskap.

Ansökan

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan om detta låter som rätt möjlighet för dig.

Vi arbetar kompetensbaserat i våra rekryteringar och fokuserar på att hitta den person som bäst matchar tjänstens kravprofil. För slutkandidater i processen kan utdrag ur belastningsregistret komma att begäras.

Som ett första steg i vår urvalsprocess kan du få genomföra rekryteringstester som hjälper oss att säkerställa en rättvis och träffsäker matchning.

title: Account Executive - SMB
description:
About us

Soundtrack is a B2B scale-up company that originated through a partnership with Spotify, previously powering the ‘Spotify Business’ service, and now provides its own music streaming platform for businesses. We serve small customers like the café around the corner, and much bigger brands like IKEA, Barbour, Espresso House and Hard Rock Cafe..

On the inside, we're a team of talented, motivated, and humble individuals, including our dedicated Sales, Customer Success, and Partner teams, alongside our expert Designers, Engineers, and Music specialists.

The Role

We’re looking for a self-motivated, collaborative and curious Account Executive to join our Sales team in Stockholm.

You’ll focus on handling inbound leads from small businesses that have 1–5 locations, with the goal of converting them into happy paying customers. You’ll be working with a high volume of around 250 leads per month, using email and short 15-minute calls to close deals through a scalable process.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives on structure, velocity, and the satisfaction of closing many wins, all while delivering a great customer experience.

You’ll report directly to our VP Sales.

Responsibilities

    

Convert leads to customers efficiently at scale

    

Talk to prospects via email or video calls

    

Use automation and AI to enable closing at scale

    

Tailor the pitch to each lead’s use case — from restaurants to bars and retail stores

    

Track your pipeline, forecast monthly MRR, and report on key conversion metrics

    

Work collaboratively with the Sales team to continuously improve the process and playbook; your efforts will shape how we scale SMB sales globally

    

Work independently while staying closely aligned with the wider Sales team

About You

You take ownership, act with purpose, and thrive on making things happen. You're driven by results and consistently aim to exceed expectations. Motivated by impact and revenue, you bring a strong performance mindset to everything you do, all while maintaining a sharp focus on delivering an exceptional customer experience.

You're goal-oriented and proactive, yet thoughtful and empathetic in your approach. High-volume sales energize you, and you know how to balance speed with precision. You take pride in guiding prospects through the decision-making process with clarity, care, and confidence.

Naturally curious, you ask questions, look for smarter ways to work, and see feedback as an opportunity to grow. You love closing deals, and you're passionate about delivering proven results that move the business forward.

And if you love music like we do, even better!

Requirements

    

2+ years of experience in SaaS sales, preferably inbound or SMB-focused

    

Experience working with CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive

    

Excellent communication skills — fast, clear, and empathetic

    

Experience improving and optimizing sales and operational processes

    

Fluency in English and at least one of the following languages: German, French, or Spanish. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential.

    

Based in Stockholm, Sweden.  

Preferred Qualifications

    

Experience supporting customers with audio hardware setups

    

Experience improving and optimizing sales and operational processes

Employee Benefits

    

We offer a flexible workplace with the possibility to work remotely

    

Generous pension plan

    

Yearly budget for health, wellness and personal development

    

Laptop and mobile phone of your choice with included cellular subscription

    

Regular social activities such as team events, meet ups, after works and off-sites

    

Daily breakfast served at the office

At Soundtrack, we believe that diversity fuels creativity and innovation. We're committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from individuals of all races, ethnicities, genders, ages, abilities, religions, sexual orientations, and identities.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we identify a suitable candidate before the application deadline. To ensure consideration, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Please note that we only accept applications submitted via our career page and do not accept applications by e-mail.

title: Automotive Program & Cost Controller
description:
In this role, you will support the financial management and development of vehicle programs across key milestones and throughout the product lifecycle. As the financial controller for assigned model-year programs, you will partner closely with Program Management and cross-functional teams to provide financial transparency, enable informed decision-making, and support efficient program execution.

The position covers both program investments and vehicle profitability, combining strategic financial planning with hands-on business controlling. You will collaborate with stakeholders across functions such as Program Management, Research & Development, Manufacturing, Design, Procurement, Business Planning, Volume Planning, and Finance.

The role also involves close collaboration with external partners and manufacturing organizations responsible for providing development cost quotations, investment estimates, and production-related financial data.

You will contribute to key financial planning cycles, including forecasting, budgeting, and long-term business planning, covering investment expenditure, product costs, and vehicle profitability for your assigned programs.

In addition to program controlling, the position includes financial controlling responsibilities related to manufacturing plants, providing exposure to both program finance and product/manufacturing cost controlling.

Key Responsibilities

    

Manage and communicate the financial development of model-year programs against agreed targets, budgets, and milestones.

    

Act as a financial business partner to Program Management, providing reliable financial information, analysis, and decision support throughout the program lifecycle.

    

Serve as a key point of contact for program-related financial topics across Finance and operational functions.

    

Consolidate, analyse, and present investment, cost, and profitability information for key program milestones, including variance analysis and explanations of underlying business drivers.

    

Support decisions concerning capital expenditure (CAPEX), product profitability, and short- and long-term financial planning through analyses, business cases, and financial investigations.

    

Coordinate financial input from multiple functions to ensure accurate and consistent program planning, forecasting, and reporting.

    

Manage financial controlling activities related to manufacturing operations, ensuring robust reporting, analysis, and assessment of financial performance.

    

Analyse manufacturing and transfer-pricing structures in close cooperation with relevant finance and controlling stakeholders.

    

Develop and support business cases and financial investigations related to manufacturing operations, including Bill of Material (BOM) development, cost-improvement initiatives, and cost-reduction tracking.

    

Identify financial risks and opportunities and provide actionable insights to relevant stakeholders.

What Will Make You Successful

You have a strong analytical mindset and are comfortable working with complex financial and operational information. You can translate detailed data into clear business insights and communicate effectively with stakeholders from different functions and levels of the organization.

You enjoy working in a cross-functional and international environment and are comfortable balancing strategic financial planning with operational business support. You are structured, proactive, and able to coordinate inputs from multiple stakeholders while maintaining a clear view of deadlines, priorities, and financial targets.

Competence Requirements

    

3–10 years of experience in financial controlling or financial analyst roles.

    

Excellent analytical capabilities.

    

Strong Excel skills and experience handling data.

    

Experience in controlling, including setting targets and monitoring performance against them.

    

Strong project management skills, with the ability to act as a central point for coordinating and consolidating input from numerous internal stakeholders.

    

Understanding of potential cost and revenue drivers within the automotive industry.

Other Requirements

    

Self-motivated and driven, with a proactive approach to resolving issues and identifying potential improvements.

    

Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with multiple stakeholders.

    

A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Production Supervisor, Machining D&M  Husqvarna Group
description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it.

Would you like to develop both people and processes in a modern manufacturing environment?

We are now looking for an engaged and driven Production Supervisor to join Machining D&M in Huskvarna. In this position, you will combine close and supportive leadership with a strong focus on safety, quality, delivery and continuous improvement. You will be an important member of the D&M management team, with the opportunity to influence both daily operations and the and the strategy of the business.

About the role

As Production Supervisor, you will be responsible for the day-to-day leadership and operations within Machining D&M. Through visible, supportive and coaching leadership, you will develop the organization while keeping people, safety and performance at the center.

You will have direct responsibility for a team of process operators and technicians. You will also work closely with colleagues within quality, engineering, maintenance and logistics to ensure that the organization achieves its targets.

An important part of the role is to lead continuous improvement activities in line with HOS, the Husqvarna Operating System, and to ensure that the department meets our high standards for quality, delivery performance and operational efficiency.

Your main responsibilities will include

    Leading the daily operations and performance of Machining D&M
    Managing, coaching and developing a team of process operators and technicians
    Ensuring achievement of targets within safety, quality, delivery and cost
    Driving continuous improvement and operational excellence in line with HOS
    Developing people, capabilities and a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement

About you

You are a confident, clear and engaging leader with a genuine interest in both people and technology. You create involvement, build strong teams and drive development through a coaching and supportive leadership style.

You enjoy working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where change and continuous improvement are natural parts of everyday work. You are comfortable setting expectations and following up on results, while remaining present and accessible to your team.

To succeed in the role, we also believe that you are collaborative, structured and able to turn operational challenges into practical actions and improvements.

Your skills and background

    Experience of leading employees within a manufacturing environment, for example as a team leader
    Experience of driving continuous improvement and change initiatives
    A good understanding of manufacturing processes and operational development
    The ability to analyze results and translate them into concrete actions
    Good communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be considered an advantage:

    HOS, Lean or a comparable production system
    CNC machining or other machining operations
    Work environment management and rehabilitation processes
    Post-secondary education within engineering, production, manufacturing or leadership

Location

This position is based in Huskvarna, Sweden.

How we work

As a Production Supervisor, you will be a hands-on leader in our production environment, working closely with your team and the wider organization every day. Your physical presence on site is essential to ensure smooth operations, enable fast decision-making, foster collaboration and provide visible, supportive leadership.

We believe that being close to the operation and the people who make it happen creates the best conditions for learning, continuous improvement and great results. This role is based full time on site.

Your application

Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we have found the right person.

For more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Niclas Thulin niclas.thulin@husqvarnagroup.com

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Kristin Sundlo Kristin.sundlo@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application, we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice: https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people. As a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow and every contribution matters.

Our culture is built on three core themes:

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work and bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

Learn more about our culture here: https://www.husqvarnagroup.com/en/our-culture

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Geriatrie 80-100% für die Region Döttingen gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Döttingen sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Geriatrie.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Döttingen

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Geriatrie

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Döttingen

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Döttingen liegt in der reizvollen Landschaft des Aargaus und besticht durch seine verkehrsgünstige Lage an der Bahnlinie Zürich-Bern. Sie profitieren von einer ausgezeichneten Anbindung an die Schweizer Wirtschaftszentren und gleichzeitig von der Nähe zur idyllischen Natur des Limmatals. Die Region bietet Ihnen als Arbeitsort eine harmonische Mischung aus ländlichem Charakter und urbaner Erreichbarkeit, was sie besonders für Pendler attraktiv macht.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Döttingen

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Geriatrie

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Geriatrie in Döttingen verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Döttingen verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachkräften in der Geriatrie, da der demografische Wandel den Bedarf an qualifiziertem Personal kontinuierlich steigert. Sie profitieren als Fachperson HF/FH von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können zwischen verschiedenen Arbeitgebern wählen. yaPersonal unterstützt Sie als spezialisierter Vermittler durch direkten Zugang zu geeigneten Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum und erspart Ihnen zeitaufwendige Bewerbungsprozesse, während wir Sie optimal in Ihrer Karriereentwicklung begleiten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Döttingen

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Geriatrie in Döttingen

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

title: ICUS 1 – Infirmier/ère coordinateur/trice d'unité de soins
description:
Ref 2580344 \| Date: 22 Sept 2026

![Association les Châtaigniers]( )

L’Association Les Châtaigniers exploite un établissement médico\-social (EMS), une organisation d’aide et de soins à domicile (OSAD) ainsi qu’une organisation d’ergothérapie. Elle considère que la qualité des prestations repose avant tout sur les femmes et les hommes qui les rendent possibles.



Elle développe une organisation fondée sur la compétence, la responsabilité, la confiance, la transparence et l’amélioration continue. Chaque membre du personnel participe activement à une gouvernance clinique exigeante, favorisant le développement des compétences, la coopération interprofessionnelle et l'innovation organisationnelle.



L’Association inscrit l’ensemble de ses activités dans une démarche de management intégré visant à garantir la qualité des prestations, la sécurité des personnes accompagnées, la santé et la sécurité de ses collaborateurs, la protection de l’environnement et l’amélioration continue de ses pratiques.

**ICUS 1 – Infirmier/ère coordinateur/trice d'unité de soins**

En qualité d’Infirmier(ère) coordinateur(trice) d'unité de soins (ICUS), vous exercez les missions fondamentales de la profession infirmière, auxquelles s’ajoutent des responsabilités de coordination clinique, d'organisation des soins, d'encadrement des équipes et d'amélioration continue de la qualité.



Vous participez quotidiennement à la pratique clinique et à la réalisation des soins, tout en garantissant leur organisation, leur continuité, leur sécurité et leur conformité aux exigences professionnelles et institutionnelles.



Vos missions comprennent notamment :



* L’évaluation clinique des besoins en soins ;
* le raisonnement clinique ;
* la planification des interventions ;
* la coordination interprofessionnelle ;
* la réalisation des prestations infirmières ;
* la délégation et la supervision des activités de soins ;
* la documentation clinique ;
* la communication avec les résidants, les bénéficiaires, leurs proches et les partenaires du réseau ;
* la prévention et la promotion de la santé ;
* la qualité, la sécurité et la gestion des risques ;
* l’encadrement, la formation et le développement des compétences des professionnels.


**Profil recherché**



Vous êtes un·e infirmier·ère diplômé·e appelé·e à exercer une fonction d'encadrement de proximité conciliant pratique clinique, coordination des soins, organisation des prestations et développement des compétences professionnelles.



Vous répondez notamment aux conditions suivantes :



* Bachelor of Science HES\-SO en soins infirmiers, diplôme d'infirmier·ère ES ou titre suisse ou étranger permettant l'exercice de la profession en Suisse ; les titres étrangers doivent être reconnus par la Croix\-Rouge suisse conformément aux dispositions applicables ;
* autorisation de pratiquer dans le canton de Genève obtenue au plus tard à l’entrée en fonction ;
* expérience professionnelle confirmée en gériatrie dans l'accompagnement, les soins et la coordination des prestations destinées aux personnes âgées ; une expérience en psychogériatrie constitue un atout ;
* adhésion aux valeurs et au projet institutionnel de l'Association Les Châtaigniers ;
* personnalité professionnelle agile, participative, engagée, faisant preuve de discernement, de sens des responsabilités et d'un intérêt marqué pour le travail interprofessionnel ;
* aptitude démontrée à exercer un management de proximité favorisant la collaboration, le développement des compétences et la qualité des soins ;
* maîtrise des outils numériques professionnels du domaine des soins, notamment du dossier informatisé du résidant, des systèmes d'information cliniques et des outils collaboratifs ; la connaissance du modèle PLAISIR constitue un atout ;
* bonne maîtrise de l'environnement Microsoft 365, notamment Word, Excel et Outlook.


Une formation postgrade en management, gouvernance clinique, qualité, gériatrie, psychogériatrie, prévention et contrôle des infections, soins palliatifs ou dans tout autre domaine pertinent est souhaitée.



En l’absence d’une telle formation, la personne retenue s'engage à entreprendre une formation adaptée aux responsabilités du poste dans un délai convenu avec l'Association.



**Nous offrons**



Un environnement de travail interprofessionnel, au sein d’une institution à taille humaine ;

description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Wädenswil sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Akutspital.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wädenswil – die Eckdaten Ihrer Stelle

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Wädenswil

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wädenswil liegt malerisch am Zürichsee im Kanton Zürich und besticht durch seine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung via S-Bahn sowie Buslinien. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine perfekte Balance zwischen beruflichen Chancen und hoher Lebensqualität mit direkter Seenähe. Zudem profitieren Sie von der Nähe zu Zürich und einem vielfältigen lokalen Arbeitsmarkt in innovativen Branchen.

### Das packen Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wädenswil an

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wädenswil verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Die Region Wädenswil sucht dringend qualifizierte Diplompflegefachkräfte für Akutspitäler, da der Fachkräftemangel im Gesundheitswesen anhält und flexible Pensumlösungen zunehmend gefragt sind. Sie profitieren von hervorragenden Karrierechancen, attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen und der Möglichkeit, Ihr Pensum individuell zu gestalten. iPersonal begleitet Sie als erfahrener Vermittler von der Bewerbung bis zum erfolgreichen Einstieg und nutzt seine etablierten Kontakte zu führenden Spitälern in der Region, um Ihnen schnell eine passende Stelle zu vermitteln.

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wädenswil

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

title: Gestionnaire risques et contrôle interne
description:
Ref 2580257 \| Date: 22 Sept 2026

![Genève Aéroport]( )

Rejoignez Genève Aéroport, une ville dans la ville, où plus de 200 métiers s'activent jour et nuit pour connecter Genève et sa région au monde.

Gestionnaire risques et contrôle interne (80 \- 100%)

  

Vous souhaitez relever un nouveau défi dans un environnement dynamique au cœur de multiples enjeux opérationnels, techniques et humains ?

Vous voulez contribuer à l'excellence d'un aéroport conscient des enjeux climatiques ?

Vous avez envie de rejoindre la Direction finances et services au sein du service gestion des risques et assurances pour contribuer au renforcement du dispositif de contrôle interne et de gestion des risques de Genève Aéroport ?

Alors, ce poste est fait pour vous !



**Vos responsabilités**

  

**Système de contrôle interne**

* Participer à la refonte et à la structuration du dispositif de contrôle interne
* Contribuer à l'élaboration et au déploiement du plan annuel de contrôle interne
* Identifier et formaliser les contrôles clés au sein de processus variés
* Évaluer l'efficacité des contrôles au moyen de campagnes de tests
* Analyser les écarts constatés et accompagner la mise en œuvre des actions correctives
* Collaborer avec les autres fonctions d'assurance, notamment l'audit interne et la qualité




**Gestion des incidents et retour d'expérience**

* Identifier et qualifier les incidents significatifs en lien avec les équipes concernées
* Analyser leurs causes, leurs conséquences et les limites éventuelles des mesures de maîtrise
* Formaliser les incidents et les analyses dans l'outil de gestion des risques, puis assurer le suivi des plans d'action associés
* Capitaliser sur les enseignements issus des incidents internes et externes et favoriser leur partage au sein de l'organisation


  

**Gestion des risques et sensibilisation**

* Participer à l'actualisation de la cartographie et au suivi des risques de l'organisation
* Accompagner les responsables métiers et les référents dans l'évaluation et le traitement des risques
* Concevoir et animer des actions de sensibilisation aux risques et au contrôle interne




**Reporting et projets transversaux**

* Participer à l'élaboration du reporting consolidé des risques, des contrôles, des incidents et des plans d'action
* Exploiter et participer à l'évolution des outils de gestion des risques et du contrôle interne
* Prendre part à des projets transversaux au sein de la Direction Finances et Services








**Vous êtes** titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire en gestion, finance, contrôle interne, ou d'un titre jugé équivalent dans un domaine équivalent, et vous :

* Bénéficiez de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en contrôle interne, gestion des risques ou audit interne/externe ;
* Maîtrisez les outils d'analyse et de reporting et êtes à l'aise dans l'exploitation de données.
* Êtes reconnu(e) pour votre intégrité, votre rigueur, votre pragmatisme ainsi que vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse ;
* Êtes à l'aise dans les relations humaines et savez instaurer un climat de confiance avec des interlocuteurs variés ;
* Êtes capable de travailler de manière transverse avec des interlocuteurs de différents niveaux hiérarchiques ;
* Faites preuve d'esprit d'initiative et êtes capable d'accompagner les métiers en formulant des recommandations pragmatiques et adaptées à leurs besoins.
* Faites preuve d'un bon esprit de collaboration et savez faire adhérer vos interlocuteurs aux démarches de maîtrise des risques et de contrôle interne.


  

**Embarquez pour une expérience unique !**

* Un cadre stimulant et innovant qui place l'excellence opérationnelle et environnementale au cœur de ses priorités pour faire grandir vos compétences.
* Une expérience unique dans une "ville dans la ville" dans un écosystème en pleine évolution, où votre travail prend une nouvelle dimension et où chaque contribution compte.
* Un environnement de travail de qualité et flexible avec des conditions de travail attractives pour le bon équilibre entre carrière et mode de vie.




**Entrée en fonction** : à convenir

**Taux d'activité** : 80% \- 100%

**Délai de postulation** : 4 octobre 2026



**Rejoignez\-nous !**

Postulez directement en ligne en transmettant un dossier de candidature complet (lettre de motivation, curriculum vitae, diplô et de travail).

Nous accepterons uniquement les dossiers complets reçus sur notre plateforme de recrutement.

Genève Aéroport garantit l'égalité des chances et s'engage en faveur de la diversité.
